programme.desc: Mika has a handsome boyfriend, but his short-tempered nature constantly drives her crazy. On a rainy day, he blows up at her just because she refuses to get into the car, preferring to ride a motorcycle instead, which ends up ruining their travel plans. Fed up, Mika finally dumps him. Nursing her broken heart, she decides to dress up to the nines to look her absolute best post-breakup. That's when she is thrown into the path of a handsome cotton candy vendor. He immediately gets on her nerves...

programme.desc: The adventure of Risa (Syakira Humaira), Faiz (Alessandro Gianni), and Danang (Adib Assegaf) begins during their vacation at their grandfather's village. There, their father hands them a keepsake box left by their late grandfather, containing a pair of glasses and some crayons. Initially, they look down on these old-school toys, but who would have guessed that their grandfather's parting gifts possess extraordinary magic? What kind of magical wonders do these vintage items hold?

In a desperate move, Melody visits a psychic. Without hesitation, she asks to trade Nada in for a better version of a husband, while also wishing to travel back in time. Though annoyed by the bizarre request, the psychic obliges, chanting a spell that sends her spinning into a time portal and throwing her straight into the past.

programme.desc: Rachquel Nesia truly loves her boyfriend, but she is utterly stressed out by how incredibly stingy Ridwan Ghani is. What does the future hold for their relationship?

programme.title: 孤星计划
Burning Stars
programme.desc: 白色恐怖笼罩的1920年代上海，特工李一民肩负护送关键人物脱险的绝密任务。在孤立无援、步步追杀中，他与旧日同伴重逢，连手突围敌人的重重陷阱。一群热血理想青年亦投身其中，在动荡时代中以牺牲与信念守护使命，找寻属于自己的勇气与方向。

programme.title: 鬼同你住
Coffin Homes
programme.desc: 这是一部以香港住房问题为背景的惊栗讽刺式电影，当中有三个离奇怪异的故事交织在一起。不断飙升的房地产价格，迫使市民要用尽一切方法去确保至少有个狭小的居住空间，即使要与亡者同住也在所不计。

programme.title: 临时决斗
Hit N Fun
programme.desc: 澳门拳王钟磊在现实夹缝中苦撑拳馆，坚持培训职业拳手。广告总监林雪发现男友外遇对象竟是当红拳击冠军，怒火中烧发出战书，约定擂台一决高下。她拜入钟磊门下，投身艰苦训练。在汗水与伤痛的洗礼中，林雪逐步蜕变，明白这场战斗，不再为复仇，而是自我重生。

programme.title: 叶问：终极一战
Ip Man- The Final Fight
programme.desc: 电影把这位一代宗师叶问晚年在香港的生活如实呈现–包括叶问不顾徒弟的反对，在妻子死后与红颜知己歌女的一段缘，与长子叶准之间亦师亦父的父子情，及与晋身成国际武打巨星的徒弟李小龙的重遇等。

programme.title: 全员嫌疑人
All Suspects
programme.desc: 一名警察趁休假入住民宿，同宿的还有侦探小说家、流浪汉和钢琴师。然而，当民宿主人和接待员相继遇害，这片原本宁静的地方顿时笼罩在重重疑云之中。如今，每位住客既是嫌疑人，也是侦探——他们各自隐藏的秘密，都足以揭开整个谜团的真相。

programme.title: 陪月
Confinement
programme.desc: 怀有身孕的画家王思玲在获奖后，搬进她梦寐以求的大宅，并聘请了陪月。但她在诞下女儿开始坐月的时候，屋内接二连三发生怪事，使母女二人感到极度不安…

programme.title: 我谈的那场恋爱
Love Lies
programme.desc: 妇科名医余笑琴抱着一试无妨的心态下载交友软件，却在网上邂逅一位自称法籍工程师的对象。殊不知，这位对象其实是一名绰号「少年」的新手骗子，并且是网络诈骗集团的一员。随着时间流逝，少年的愧疚感与笑琴的期望日益增强，这段关系愈演愈烈，真假难以区分。

programme.title: 盗月者
The Moon Thieves
programme.desc: 一家贼赃手表店的老板策划一组盗窃团队，成员包括大贼、爆破专家、开锁天才和二手表专家，飞往东京盗取三只名贵手表。然而，当他们偶然发现了更珍贵的手表「Moonwatch」后，行动起了变化，被日本黑帮追杀。他们必须合作力图脱身，并把手表带回香港。

programme.title: 劫数难逃
Imprisoned 2: There Is No Escape From Fate
programme.desc: 香港商人孙逸辰出国参加会议，同行的女秘书在酒店遇害，孙逸辰则被捕。即使孙逸辰自辩无罪，最终还是被关进了跨国大型监狱，狱长更常虐待囚犯。孙逸辰定要设法逃离此暗黑监狱以保命。

programme.title: 捕风追影
Shadow's Edge, The
programme.desc: 一伙天才盗匪劫走数亿资产，更以高超反侦察手段戏耍警方「天眼」系统。束手无策之际，澳门司警邀请隐退多年的跟踪专家黄德忠归队，重组「神秘跟踪队」追查幕后主谋傅隆生，一场高智商猫鼠对决随即展开。

programme.title: 催眠·裁决
Guilt By Design
programme.desc: 轰动全港的凶杀案来到审讯最后一天。就在陪审团准备退庭商议时，身为陪审员的著名催眠治疗师收到一段显示女儿被绑架的影片。绑匪威胁他必须催眠陪审团，操控最终裁决。夹在正义与亲情之间，他必须做出抉择，拯救女儿。

programme.title: 天水围的夜与雾
Night and Fog
programme.desc: 根据真实事件改编的天水围第二部曲，描述一名年长的失业男人和年轻的大陆妻子及他们两名幼女的故事。不幸的是，他们的生活苦不堪言，而令人震惊的故事结局更引发社会上对低下阶层困境的关注。

programme.title: 镖人: 风起大漠
Blades of the Guardians
programme.desc: 隋乱将至，逃犯镖客刀马受命护送神秘人，自西域大漠远赴长安。不料护送对象竟是「天字第一号逃犯」，引发各方势力围追堵截，荒漠沙海间厮杀不断。随着阴谋逐渐浮出水面，刀马被卷入一场牵动天下的朝廷与江湖博弈，在危机四伏的长安路上，展开一场生死难测的血战。

programme.title: 金钱帝国
I Corrupt All Cops
programme.desc: 在六七十年代的香港，警队贪污受贿，香港岛总探长Lak哥率领其下警队的三名贪污警察只手遮天、纵横黑白两道，港督遂成立廉政公署，决心杜绝贪污。一直受欺压的大学生韩志邦加入廉署，誓要彻底消灭Lak哥的贪污帝国，改变了香港的命运。

programme.title: 型男大主厨

programme.desc: 台湾广受欢迎的常青美食料理节目，由2006年始播至今，2011年还获选金钟奖的最佳综合节目主持人奖。每一期将有不同的主题：“大明星來下廚”由兩位明星或两个明星档分組對抗，拿出自己的拿手菜對抗比拼；“五分钟出好菜”由两位厨师根据指定食材，在五分钟内烹煮出易学美味的一道菜等。这是一个富有娱乐效果的轻松美食节目，能够持续制作这么多年不是没有理由的。

programme.title: 乡野有真味第三季

programme.desc: 《乡野有真味第三季》将镜头投向中国南方的隐秘角落——广东、广西、浙江、福建、湖南、江西、安徽、贵州八省，深入竹林溪涧、古村深巷，探访那些颠覆味蕾认知的“暗黑”美食与新奇风味，揭开乡土食材与地域文化交织的味觉密码。“Country Roads Delicious Food S3” turns to the hidden corners of southern China, the eight provinces of Guangdong, Guangxi, Zhejiang, Fujian, Hunan, Jiangxi, Anhui and Guizhou. programme.desc: 她是一个再普通不过的女人，有着一份薪水微薄的工作，一个沉默寡言的丈夫。她以为自己永远普通，直到有一天晚上，厄运猛然降临，她开始活在黑暗里。她怕有人说她那天晚上出席酒局，也怕有人说她那天晚上穿了裙子。她怕丈夫指责她不贞，也怕家人辱骂她败德。直到一切无法隐藏，她一贯寡言的丈夫坐在沙发上，抽完了最后一根烟，看向蜷缩在角落里哭得不成样子的她。然后他拉着她的手，报警，追凶，上诉。用余生和性命，去为她求一个公道，要一份天理，给一份爱。An ordinary woman with an ordinary life and an ordinary husband. Archives：The Nanyang Mystery
programme.desc: 剧集改编自南派三叔同名小说，民国初年南洋地区发生了一系列诡异事件，张海楼和张海侠两位南部档案馆的秘密探员被委派调查一起神秘案件，发现案件背后隐藏着军阀利用剧毒植物“黄昏草”散播的阴谋。在调查过程中，张海楼和张海侠经历了生死考验，张海侠甚至因此瘫痪。随着线索逐渐清晰，张海楼发现所有线索都指向一艘大船 - 南安号。 剧集改编自南派三叔同名小说，民国初年南洋地区发生了一系列诡异事件，张海楼和张海侠两位南部档案馆的秘密探员被委派调查一起神秘案件，发现案件背后隐藏着军阀利用剧毒植物“黄昏草”散播的阴谋。在调查过程中，张海楼和张海侠经历了生死考验，张海侠甚至因此瘫痪。随着线索逐渐清晰，张海楼发现所有线索都指向一艘大船 - 南安号。

programme.title: 全城地图：最强明星队
The Best Team
programme.desc: 《全城地图：最强明星队》是一运动竞技实境节目，由钱薇娟与江宏杰分别领军蓝、红两队，以城市为竞技场，穿梭全台进行团队对抗。该节目以“将城市化为竞技场”为概念，集结好手争夺最强明星队荣耀。The Best Team” is a sports reality competition programme where Taiwan national athletes and celebrities take part in Blue and Red teams respectively, using cities as their battlegrounds, travelling across Taiwan and compete against one another. Based on the concept of turning cities into arenas, the programme brings together top athletes to vie for the title of the ultimate celebrity team.

programme.title: 亦舞之城
Second Chance Romance
programme.desc: 著名芭蕾舞艺术家谭思婷盛名之下退役归国，与曾经的恋人冯睿意外重逢，经历重重波折后最终破镜重圆的故事。多年前两人因误会遗憾分手，简单真挚的校园恋爱无疾而终。久别重逢后两颗平静的心再次泛起涟漪，压抑不住对彼此的思念。而冯睿被谭思婷对芭蕾梦想的执着追求与热爱，以及对自己始终如一的情感所打动，最终冯睿放下心结勇敢追爱，有情人终成眷属，谭思婷的芭蕾事业也得以薪火相传。Ballet dancer Tan Siting retired and returned to China to teach, dedicating herself to nurturing new talent. She met a young dancer, Zheng Yufan, who was struggling, and devoted all her knowledge to help her win gold at an international competition. Tan Siting’s spirit of pursuing her dreams earned widespread acclai...

programme.title: 祈今朝
Sword and Fairy
programme.desc: 越今朝和越祈二人在乌岩村相伴三年，有着神奇的“共鸣”关系，却对各自的身世一无所知。二人携手闯荡江湖，希望找回过往记忆。双越二人被卷入启魂圣宗作乱和洛家堡血祭等神秘事件之中，而在对抗圣宗过程中意外让越祈被封印的回忆和情感被开启。随着事件发展，双越结识了洛家堡双子洛埋名和洛昭言、千年狼妖闲卿、顾寒江和明绣师徒以及居十方等江湖人士，二人的真实身份也逐渐揭开。

programme.title: 爱情没有神话
Lady Liberty
programme.desc: 该剧改编自亦舒同名小说，讲述了以林展翘、何韩为代表的独身男女们，在事业与情感的交织浪潮中，彼此形成深厚羁绊，他们不断探寻自我，最终与爱人、朋友一道绽放绚烂人生的故事。Lady Liberty” is adapted from Yi Shu’s famous novel of the same name. The drama follows Lin Zhanqiao, a financially independent woman, who is not against marriage but is unwilling to settle for less. She meets He Dezhang, and their relationship evolves as they navigate growth and choices in love and career. The drama also explores the lives of Lin Zhanqiao's female friends, their life choices, and their journey...

programme.desc: 在二十世纪九十年代初的濠港，法官秦誉与高级督察唐萱二人曾联手将社团头目韩奎龙成功定罪。然而秦誉之子意外撞伤韩家长子后，他陷入法理与亲情的两难抉择，最终竟选择伪造证据，为掩盖真相不惜伪造证据嫁祸他人，从法律的守护者坠落为规则的挑战者，将罪责嫁祸给一名偷车少年。随着唐萱深入追查这起案件，官商勾结的暗流、警界内部的腐败，以及多桩陈年旧案的隐秘关联也逐渐浮出水面，勾勒出一幅复杂的年代罪案图景。Qin Yu, who used to be an upright judge, covered up the truth that his son caused an accident and injured the son of a gang leader in a traffic collision. To avenge his son, the gang leader stirred up a storm of bloodshed.

programme.title: 在暴雪时分
Amidst a Snowstorm of Love
programme.desc: 昔日天才级职业斯诺克选手林亦扬与当红九球选手殷果相遇在一场十年难得一遇的暴雪之夜。在殷果表弟的助攻之下，两人慢慢熟识。殷果也了解到林亦扬的往事。原来林亦扬曾经也是轰动一时的斯诺克天才，在一次比赛中因对裁判判罚有异议，争取时无意冲撞裁判而被禁赛，少年气盛的他不服判决，竟直接宣布退役，从此离开了自己引以为傲的斯诺克事业。殷果的出现，让林亦扬的人生轨迹再次转变，林亦扬不仅开始努力地追求殷果，还在殷果的带动下重拾最初的梦想，返回斯诺克赛场。最终二人共攀事业高峰，一同为职业台球事业贡献力量，并携手教练与队友，共推全民健身台球项目发展。

programme.title: 祈今朝
Sword and Fairy
programme.desc: 越今朝和越祈二人在乌岩村相伴三年，有着神奇的“共鸣”关系，却对各自的身世一无所知。二人携手闯荡江湖，希望找回过往记忆。双越二人被卷入启魂圣宗作乱和洛家堡血祭等神秘事件之中，而在对抗圣宗过程中意外让越祈被封印的回忆和情感被开启。随着事件发展，双越结识了洛家堡双子洛埋名和洛昭言、千年狼妖闲卿、顾寒江和明绣师徒以及居十方等江湖人士，二人的真实身份也逐渐揭开。

programme.title: 好事成双
Alliance
programme.desc: 曾是一流大学高材生的林双，婚后迅速怀孕成了全职妈妈，但为家庭全身心付出的她遭遇背叛。离婚在即，为了争夺女儿的抚养权，林双不得不重返职场。面对婚姻、职场、亲情的种种考验，林双在好友江喜的支持下迎难而上，而背地里施以援手的旧同学顾许也忍不住对林双动心。林双用实际行动完成了从家庭主妇到职场人的转变，也收获了和顾许的美好爱情，迎来属于自己的新生活。

programme.title: 春色寄情人
Will Love In Spring
programme.desc: 陈麦冬年少时性格桀骜，遭遇生活变故后选择成为一名遗体整容师。庄洁则因车祸致残，为了追逐更好的自己，孤身在外打拼成为大城市之中的职场精英。一个是性格桀骜但身心孤独的遗体整容师，一个是身体缺陷但勇敢耀眼的医疗销售，在不断拉扯中逐渐互相理解与尊重，以爱治愈了彼此的“不完美”。

programme.title: 桃花映江山
The Princess' Gambit
programme.desc: 《桃花映江山》讲述了祁国左相沈在野因一次政敌处心积虑的陷害，与北苑国和亲公主姜桃花相识，一个腹黑狠辣，一个狡猾伶俐，在波谲云诡的两朝时局之下，二人斗智斗勇、互相算计，在面对强敌的被迫合作中又暗生情愫，在面对国家与爱情的选择，他们突破重重阻碍，共谋定江山……。The drama tells the story of a fallen princess forced into a political marriage with a corrupt prime minister. She faces numerous dangers but strives to survive to protect herself amidst the conflicts of national loyalty, personal vengeance, and true love. Meanwhile, the prime minister, outwardly ambitious to become a treacherous official, secretly harbours a desire...

programme.title: 烈焰
Burning Flames
programme.desc: 故事讲述王子武庚拥有神族和人族的双重血脉，天资不凡，桀骜不驯。然辛国被神族覆灭，父母离世，高高在上的王子沦为奴隶。武庚在困境中历经磨难，与市井少女白菜和一群志同道合的朋友相识，带领人族集结神隐部、妖族、海灵族等，携手对抗强大的神族。武庚不断磨砺成长，从国仇家恨到为天下苍生而战，不断成长强大，成为天之战神。

programme.desc: 故事讲述王子武庚拥有神族和人族的双重血脉，天资不凡，桀骜不驯。然辛国被神族覆灭，父母离世，高高在上的王子沦为奴隶。武庚在困境中历经磨难，与市井少女白菜和一群志同道合的朋友相识，带领人族集结神隐部、妖族、海灵族等，携手对抗强大的神族。武庚不断磨砺成长，从国仇家恨到为天下苍生而战，不断成长强大，成为天之战神。

programme.title: Big Cat Country Season 1
programme.desc: During the last few weeks of the dry season, the prides stick close to the only available water in the river. But in Luangwa, that proximity spells danger - especially when the scent of a hippo kill compels the Hollywoods to cross the river.

programme.title: Orangutan Jungle School Season 2
programme.desc: Beni and Lala get an unexpected visit from Vet Arga, Kesi makes a new friend on Bangamat Island, and Alejandra deals with a new view of the world after the accident at forest school leaves her blind in one eye.

programme.title: Wildlife ER Season 3
programme.desc: Juggle the demands of caring for sick koala joeys with vet Claire, then see what it takes to save a squirrel glider caught in barbed wire. Take care of an exhausted owl and get a big surprise when vet Tim X-rays a turtle that was struck by a car.

programme.title: Wildlife ER Season 3
programme.desc: Follow vet Tim as he races to save rescued koala Ashley, then meet a flying fox with an extra digit who needs some TLC from vet Martine. Calculate the odds for a run-over kangaroo joey with vet Emily, then celebrate the release of 50 lorikeets.

programme.title: Shark Squad Season 1
programme.desc: Often portrayed as mindless eating machines prone to attacking humans, sharks are more complex and intelligent than previously thought. Find out how these graceful top predators interact, choose friends, and even teach other sharks.

programme.title: Africa's Wild Year Season 1
programme.desc: In Southern Africa, Spring starts in early September and the natural world stirs into life. Days begin to lengthen, temperatures rise, and animals and plants combine in an orchestrated effort to reproduce, give birth and raise their young.

programme.title: Africa's Wild Year Season 1
programme.desc: Summer in Africa is a season of extremes, it separates the weak from the strong. It tests the survival instincts of cheetahs, lions, geckos, turtles and many more species as they search for food and water in the extreme heat of summer.

programme.title: Baby Animals Season 1
programme.desc: The animal kingdom can be cold and unforgiving, but for baby baboons, penguins, capybaras, and emperor tamarins, having a helpful family makes life a little easier.

programme.title: Secret Life of the Tasmanian Devil Season 1
programme.desc: For Tasmanian devils, dominance is the name of the game during mating season. Meet males who fight for the right to pass on their genes, and learn about the violent, noisy etiquette of these carnivorous marsupials' mealtime.

programme.title: Big Cats, Small World Season 1
programme.desc: Welcome spring on the Gomoti River, where cheetah mum Phefo and lion mum Tshaba teach their cubs survival skills and keep them out of the jaws of the big male cats. See lion king Molelo go into battle while leopard Senatia tries to ensure his legacy.

programme.title: Great Parks of Africa Season 2
programme.desc: In a park where land meets sea, the natural elements combine to create wonderful variety. Cola-colored water feeds forests green and dense. Fire and wind fuel growth in great diversity and rock shapes a coastline of many faces. Life thrives here - from the magnificent to the bizarre. This is the Garden Route National Park.

programme.title: Great Parks of Africa Season 2
programme.desc: In the northern reaches of the Kruger National Park, life depends on one thing – water. In a land burdened by heat and drought a single ribbon cuts its reliable course through the wilderness. It's a lifeline to all creatures, great and small.

programme.title: Great Parks of Africa Season 2
programme.desc: Augrabies is where the mighty Orange River plunges over the awesome 56 meter Augrabies waterfall. Derived from a word “oukurubes” which means “place of thunder” in the indigenous language of the Nama-Khoi this land is the heart of a harsh and sun-beaten world with flashes of brilliant color and a thunderous roar.

programme.title: Great Parks of Africa Season 2
programme.desc: Food, water and shelter are essential to all life on earth from the smallest of beings to the largest, and along the banks of one of Africa's greatest rivers, some animals struggle while others thrive. A rhythm drives all animals as they journey in search of what they need to survive, and each must decide where and when to move if they're to succeed... These are the magical worlds of the Lower Zambezi.

programme.title: Great Parks of Africa Season 2
programme.desc: In the heart of Zululand, South Africa, lies the oldest game reserve on the African continent – Hluhluwe-iMfolozi. Here, Southern white rhinos have found protection from people in times of turmoil. Hunted almost to extinction at the end of the 19th century, the park's establishment gave rhinos a lifeline – breeding them back from extinction.

programme.title: Big Cat Country Season 1
programme.desc: When the all-female Hollywood pride encounters the Nomads, a new pride of rival males, they may have found the answer to their mating dry spell. But they quickly realize that it will not be a happy encounter.

programme.title: Big Cat Country Season 1
programme.desc: The Hollywood pride reels after the Nomad's brutal attack on their leader, Ava, leaves her desperately weak and unable to hunt. To add to her woes, her hungry pride start rejecting her. But without her, they struggle to bring down prey.

programme.title: Big Cat Country Season 1
programme.desc: The lions of the Nomad pride rampage deep into the heart of the MK pride's territory, scattering its members and coming dangerously close to the five new MK cubs. Meanwhile, the Hollywoods are recovering, and Ava's survival skills are still intact.

programme.title: Big Cat Country Season 1
programme.desc: After the dry season lowers the waters, siblings Kimba and Maya risk crossing the river to search for their parents. They run the gauntlet of the densest populations of crocs and hippos in Africa, and face an even greater threat on the other side.

programme.title: Big Cat Country Season 1
programme.desc: During the last few weeks of the dry season, the prides stick close to the only available water in the river. But in Luangwa, that proximity spells danger - especially when the scent of a hippo kill compels the Hollywoods to cross the river.

programme.title: Beasts of the Big Blue Season 1
programme.desc: Take a deep dive into the teeming waters of the Hauraki Gulf, near Auckland, New Zealand, and explore a true paradise for ocean creatures. Catch a glimpse of a stealthy manta ray, enjoy dolphin antics, and admire a kaleidoscope of tropical fish.

programme.title: Beasts of the Big Blue Season 1
programme.desc: Delve into the strange magic of the Three Kings Islands, a remote archipelago north of New Zealand. Swim with a pod of bottlenose dolphins, join short-tailed stingrays on a hunt, and feel the tension as a gang of predatory orcas arrives on the scene.

programme.title: Superbeast Season 1
programme.desc: Bow down to one of nature's most ancient and deadly endurance predators. Watch tiger sharks exploit turtle nesting chaos, survive oxygen-poor environments with epaulette sharks, and withstand the crushing pressure of the deep with ghost sharks.

programme.title: Superbeast Season 1
programme.desc: Prowl the ocean with sharks of all kinds and see why these predatory fish reign supreme under the sea. Stalk coral labyrinths with reef sharks, lie in wait for the perfect strike with wobbegongs, and embark on epic migrations with great whites.

programme.title: Deep Dive North America Season 1
programme.desc: Marvel at North America's natural wonders as Lizzie swims through astonishing coral reefs, digs for ancient fossils, and treks through jungles on tropical shores. Prowl with jaguars that stalk a Costa Rican beach and meet the planet's biggest sharks.

programme.title: Deep Dive North America Season 1
programme.desc: Tag along with Lizzie on her most dangerous Atlantic adventure yet: free diving with bull sharks. Explore otherworldly Gulf Coast swamps filled with hungry alligators, crafty snapping turtles, and tiny but mighty beach mice who strengthen sand dunes.

programme.title: Deep Dive North America Season 1
programme.desc: Bundle up as Lizzie heads north to tag sharks and witness first-hand the slow, sobering disappearance of sea ice. Do time in bear jail with polar bears who are caught raiding a town for food after their icy hunting grounds diminish.

programme.title: 美好生活荔枝幫
A Wonderful Life Starts with Health
programme.desc: 兼顧情緒價值輸出，為女性量身打造兼具時尚審美與人文關懷的變裝微綜藝，全方位多角度地向社會傳遞積極的生活態度；種草生活好物、推薦文旅線路、科普健康知識。

programme.title: 音你而來 第3季
The Melody of You Season 3
programme.desc: 「音樂+旅行+社交」的唱演真人秀，由王赫野、王琳凱、張碧晨三位老友攜手劉雨昕、周震南、姚曉棠、容祖兒等多位新朋友，跟隨「音你小隊」開啟全新的集體旅居生活；音樂人將在絕美的自然風光中尋找創作靈感，通過音樂與當地人產生連接與互動，帶來一場充滿人情味的治療音樂之旅。

programme.title: 緣來不晚 第4季
Love Never Comes Late Season 4
programme.desc: 專為資深單身人士定制的相親交友節目，每集有4位男嘉賓和3位女嘉賓，依序進行一對一交流。未上場嘉賓則分別在男女嘉賓室觀察場上溝通情況，加深對有意對象的瞭解。節目主張為愛回歸，愛情不分年齡，緣來從來不晚。

programme.title: 非誠勿擾(2019) (S10)
Perfect Match (2019)

programme.title: 美好生活荔枝幫
A Wonderful Life Starts with Health
programme.desc: 兼顧情緒價值輸出，為女性量身打造兼具時尚審美與人文關懷的變裝微綜藝，全方位多角度地向社會傳遞積極的生活態度；種草生活好物、推薦文旅線路、科普健康知識。

programme.title: 食色生香
The Foodie Journey
programme.desc: 中華飲食文化博大精深，不同的地域都有自己的招牌美食，每個人對於美食都有著不同的記憶。《食色生香》挖掘美食背後的故事，傳承中華美食文化。

programme.title: 與君渡長歡 (短劇)
Eternal Joy With You (Mini drama)
programme.desc: 藥商之女許婉寧前世遭丈夫背叛、親生骨肉被害，含恨重生；為了守護孩子並復仇，她與調查禁藥的金鱗衛大督主裴珩結盟，兩人從互有成見的試探，到相知相許的聯手，不僅粉碎了危害朝政的驚天陰謀，更在夢境與現實的交錯中，讓女主重獲自救的勇氣，開啟了全新人生。

programme.title: 夙夜集 (短劇)
The Rebirth (Mini drama)
programme.desc: 蒼梧國大將軍之女羲和遭滅門及暗算，重生為廢柴嫡女沈千夜。她懷著滿腔不甘踏上復仇之路，與疑似凶手的「小皇叔」裴夙糾纏不休。在調查真相的過程中，兩人從相互算計到聯手抗敵，揭開了蒼梧國隱藏的重重秘密。

programme.title: 國醫少年志 第2季

programme.desc: 由徐璐、夏之光、高瀚宇、李雅娟組成國醫少年團，通過年輕化視角拆解中醫奧秘，讓中醫藥文化穿越千年時光，讓更多的年輕人讀懂中醫、愛上中醫，看見傳統醫學在現代生活中的蓬勃生命力。

programme.title: 半熟戀人 第4季

programme.desc: 30+的素人嘉賓們帶著成熟與期待，在摩登都市上海入住郊區小屋，從陌生到熟悉，從心動到堅定，共同開啟一段30天的尋愛之旅；除了元老嘉賓謝楠、張純燁、唐藝昕之外，更邀請了徐藝洋和顏安等組成「半熟觀察員」，一同見證高甜瞬間。

programme.title: 我和我的父辈
My Country, My Parents
programme.desc: 电影由四个单元故事组成，分别由吴京、章子怡、徐峥、沈腾执导及主演，以不同中国时代为背景，通过「家与国」为题，描写几代父辈的奋斗经历，讲述中国人的血脉相连和精神传承，再现中国人努力拼搏的时代记忆。

programme.title: 临时劫案
Rob N Roll
programme.desc: 悍匪梅蓝天策动了「闪电械劫」，阴差阳错撞上也正在筹划打劫的慕容辉及笠水，于是三人结盟。最后这宗临时械劫却惹来警察追捕，并展开一场激烈的追逐战，三人的性命也危在旦夕！

programme.title: 做个有钱人
I Want to be Rich
programme.desc: 出身贫寒的阿华，肩负照顾嗜赌父母与年幼弟妹之重担。凭着坚毅意志与过人决心，他于逆境中奋起，为家人开创更好生活，最终在房地产界闯出一片天，证明了坚持终有回报。

programme.title: 旺角监狱
To Live and Die in Mongkok
programme.desc: 辉(张家辉 饰) 是仁义社的杀手，旺角是仁义社的地盘。为尽江湖手足情，辉便代替「兄弟」箭猪(韦家雄 饰)去斩杀廿多名黑道中人。当年往逮捕细辉的探员枪王余 (廖启智 饰)碰到他，吓得屁滚尿流，连警枪都跌了。本来，辉要置他于死地，但讲道义的细辉，见枪王余这样可怜，放他一马，却反被枪王余在他背后轰了一枪，不单受伤，还被拘捕下狱三十年。可是，辉亦因此成为仁义社的英雄，旺角的传奇！出狱后，辉已和社会脱节，回到面目全非的旺角，差点连回家也不懂。受精神分裂症影响，他以为永远也逃不出旺角，就像置身于监狱一样。在旺角的黑道上，他出手救了来自内地的一对姊妹，其中妹妹是弱智的，却惹来不少麻烦。 好不容易回到旺角老家，发现已年迈母亲患上老人痴呆症，连自己儿子也认不到...有一天，辉母突然清醒与辉相认，却于同一天逝世。 辉为营救这对落难姊妹，招来了杀身之祸，黑白两道狂追猛打...

programme.title: 传说
A Legend
programme.desc: 考古专家房教授发现冰川考察中的出土文物与他梦中见到的玉佩极为相似。为揭开梦中的真相，房教授带领考察团队深入冰川，共同踏上一场奇幻冒险之旅。

programme.title: 白昼如焚
As It Burns
programme.desc: 探员魏允调查言贞在爆炸中死亡的案件，看似平凡的意外，魏允却认为疑点重重。直至他看见言贞儿时好友卢子峰的女友林音长得跟言贞十分相像，魏允随即发现连串扑朔迷离的关系，并合过去及现在的案情细节后，真相更是出人意表。

programme.title: 长安的荔枝
The Lychee Road
programme.desc: 一「荔」千金，盛唐爆笑开跑！小吏李善德奉命运送岭南贡果，须在荔枝变坏前的三日内，将鲜果跨越千里送达长安，只为满足贵妃一尝其鲜。沿途关卡重重、阻碍不断，在权力与荒诞交织下，这场「不可能任务」既惊险又讽刺，最终迎来一段笑泪交织的结局。

programme.title: 哪咤之魔童闹海
Ne Zha 2
programme.desc: 天劫之后，哪咤和敖丙的灵魂虽得以保全，但肉身即将消散。太乙真人计划借助神秘的七色宝莲为他们重塑肉身，却在过程中遇到诸多困难。敌人步步紧逼，命运未卜，两人能否重获新生，改写未来？

programme.title: 恶行之外
Beyond The Sin
programme.desc: 督察乐一言的独生女惨遭杀害，她的同班同学邱俊文因此被捕。乐一言原以为案件已告一段落，于是黯然离开警队。然而，邱俊文入狱后，接连又有多名女孩遭遇不测。此时，乐一言开始怀疑真正的凶手仍逍遥法外，并誓要查明真相。

programme.title: 得宠先生
An Abandoned Team
programme.desc: 独居的佳叔脾气暴躁。他因被迫退休、婚姻失败以及与女儿关系疏离而感到人生无望，最终决定结束自己的生命。然而，他意外地被一只流浪狗和一位动物义工所救，并重新找回了人生的意义。

programme.title: 武替道
Stuntman
programme.desc: 因昔日拍档导演希望完成其人生最后一部作品，过气动作导演李森重出江湖担任动作指导。他与一位雄心壮志的年轻动作演员，两代人为了重振名声，甘愿赔上一切。同时，李森必须克服自己的坏脾气，面对过去的错误，并努力修补与疏离女儿之间破裂的关系。
1921重现了中国共产党第一次召开全国代表大会的波澜壮阔历史时刻。影片以独有的青春格调结合谍战元素、国际视角等多个精彩看点，打造出庆祝建党一百周年的第一大片。

programme.title: SAYAP CINTA TERINDAH EPS 28

programme.title: CAHAYA TERINDAH EPS 58-59
programme.desc: A drama series that tells the story of Indah (Ranty Maria) and her struggle to find her biological family after discovering that she was adopted. programme.title: TURUN RANJANG EPS 29
programme.desc: Albi (Samuel Zylgwyn) is forced to marry his sister-in-law, Naza (Rachquel Nesia), at the request of his father-in-law, Wira. This decision is made for the sake of caring for baby Zia (Faradilla Yoshi), Albi's wife, who falls into a coma after giving birth. This pressured marriage becomes difficult for both Albi and Naza, as they were previously in love with other people.

programme.title: 全城地图：最强明星队
The Best Team
programme.desc: 《全城地图：最强明星队》是一运动竞技实境节目，由钱薇娟与江宏杰分别领军蓝、红两队，以城市为竞技场，穿梭全台进行团队对抗。该节目以“将城市化为竞技场”为概念，集结好手争夺最强明星队荣耀。The Best Team” is a sports reality competition programme where Taiwan national athletes and celebrities take part in Blue and Red teams respectively, using cities as their battlegrounds, travelling across Taiwan and compete against one another. Based on the concept of turning cities into arenas, the programme brings together top athletes to vie for the title of the ultimate celebrity team.

programme.title: 型男大主厨
Stylish Man
programme.desc: 台湾广受欢迎的常青美食料理节目，由2006年始播至今，2011年还获选金钟奖的最佳综合节目主持人奖。每一期将有不同的主题：“大明星來下廚”由兩位明星或两个明星档分組對抗，拿出自己的拿手菜對抗比拼；“五分钟出好菜”由两位厨师根据指定食材，在五分钟内烹煮出易学美味的一道菜等。这是一个富有娱乐效果的轻松美食节目，能够持续制作这么多年不是没有理由的。

programme.title: 勇敢无双龙秀晶
The Brave Yong Su Jeong
programme.desc: 该剧为一部浪漫复仇剧，讲述了梦想成为现代版巨商林尚玉的女子龙秀晶与将命运托付给她的吝啬鬼绝症患者吕义柱相遇后，两人共同展开复仇的故事。剧中还涉及与财阀家族相关的出生秘密等人物关系。Yong Su-Jeong is a popular but shy-in-love host who has a crush on a rich heir, Joo Woo-Jin, while hardworking Yeo Ui-Joo’s life changes when he discovers he’s also part of the same wealthy family.

programme.title: 焦急的恋爱
My Military Valentine
programme.desc: 南北韩停战宣言后的未来，为实现南北统一而在DMZ建设的试点智慧城市和平市。作为韩国顶流偶像的劳埃德在和平市结束庆祝汇演后，在进行罕见军械装备交易时，遇到当时执行炸弹搜索任务的朝鲜特种兵英玉，被她误认为是恐怖分子。更糟糕的是，在那一瞬间有记者们还拍下了照片，劳埃德陷入了丑闻之中，对英玉的第一印象可谓强烈。为了躲避丑闻而入伍的劳埃德，在部队与教官英玉再次见面。某天，完成反恐训练从训练场返回生活馆的途中，劳埃德从行军队伍中掉队，迷路彷徨之时遇到被反统一极右派团体 “紫罗兰” 追赶的自己的超级粉丝韩松伊。

programme.title: 一城一味 长安有滋味
One City One Taste Xi An
programme.desc: 《一城一味·长安有滋味》将以西安为核心，辐射咸阳、宝鸡、榆林、汉中等地，从地域美食、风土人情等方面切入，通过一个个鲜活生动的故事，以小见大，多方位记录和展现一座城的多维之味，让观众品尝到陕西人的热度与温度。

programme.title: 全城地图：最强明星队
The Best Team
programme.desc: 《全城地图：最强明星队》是一运动竞技实境节目，由钱薇娟与江宏杰分别领军蓝、红两队，以城市为竞技场，穿梭全台进行团队对抗。该节目以“将城市化为竞技场”为概念，集结好手争夺最强明星队荣耀。The Best Team” is a sports reality competition programme where Taiwan national athletes and celebrities take part in Blue and Red teams respectively, using cities as their battlegrounds, travelling across Taiwan and compete against one another. Based on the concept of turning cities into arenas, the programme brings together top athletes to vie for the title of the ultimate celebrity team.

programme.title: 乡野有真味第三季

programme.desc: 《乡野有真味第三季》将镜头投向中国南方的隐秘角落——广东、广西、浙江、福建、湖南、江西、安徽、贵州八省，深入竹林溪涧、古村深巷，探访那些颠覆味蕾认知的“暗黑”美食与新奇风味，揭开乡土食材与地域文化交织的味觉密码。“Country Roads Delicious Food S3” turns to the hidden corners of southern China, the eight provinces of Guangdong, Guangxi, Zhejiang, Fujian, Hunan, Jiangxi, Anhui and Guizhou. programme.title: 烈焰
Burning Flames
programme.desc: 故事讲述王子武庚拥有神族和人族的双重血脉，天资不凡，桀骜不驯。然辛国被神族覆灭，父母离世，高高在上的王子沦为奴隶。武庚在困境中历经磨难，与市井少女白菜和一群志同道合的朋友相识，带领人族集结神隐部、妖族、海灵族等，携手对抗强大的神族。武庚不断磨砺成长，从国仇家恨到为天下苍生而战，不断成长强大，成为天之战神。

programme.title: 好事成双
Alliance

programme.desc: 《桃花映江山》讲述了祁国左相沈在野因一次政敌处心积虑的陷害，与北苑国和亲公主姜桃花相识，一个腹黑狠辣，一个狡猾伶俐，在波谲云诡的两朝时局之下，二人斗智斗勇、互相算计，在面对强敌的被迫合作中又暗生情愫，在面对国家与爱情的选择，他们突破重重阻碍，共谋定江山……。The drama tells the story of a fallen princess forced into a political marriage with a corrupt prime minister. She faces numerous dangers but strives to survive to protect herself amidst the conflicts of national loyalty, personal vengeance, and true love. Meanwhile, the prime minister, outwardly ambitious to become a treacherous official, secretly harbours a desire...

programme.title: 烈焰
Burning Flames
programme.desc: 故事讲述王子武庚拥有神族和人族的双重血脉，天资不凡，桀骜不驯。然辛国被神族覆灭，父母离世，高高在上的王子沦为奴隶。武庚在困境中历经磨难，与市井少女白菜和一群志同道合的朋友相识，带领人族集结神隐部、妖族、海灵族等，携手对抗强大的神族。武庚不断磨砺成长，从国仇家恨到为天下苍生而战，不断成长强大，成为天之战神。

programme.title: Beasts of the Big Blue Season 1
programme.desc: Delve into the strange magic of the Three Kings Islands, a remote archipelago north of New Zealand. Swim with a pod of bottlenose dolphins, join short-tailed stingrays on a hunt, and feel the tension as a gang of predatory orcas arrives on the scene.

programme.title: Superbeast Season 1
programme.desc: Bow down to one of nature's most ancient and deadly endurance predators. Watch tiger sharks exploit turtle nesting chaos, survive oxygen-poor environments with epaulette sharks, and withstand the crushing pressure of the deep with ghost sharks.

programme.title: Superbeast Season 1
programme.desc: Prowl the ocean with sharks of all kinds and see why these predatory fish reign supreme under the sea. Stalk coral labyrinths with reef sharks, lie in wait for the perfect strike with wobbegongs, and embark on epic migrations with great whites.

programme.title: Deep Dive North America Season 1
programme.desc: Marvel at North America's natural wonders as Lizzie swims through astonishing coral reefs, digs for ancient fossils, and treks through jungles on tropical shores. Prowl with jaguars that stalk a Costa Rican beach and meet the planet's biggest sharks.

programme.title: Deep Dive North America Season 1
programme.desc: Tag along with Lizzie on her most dangerous Atlantic adventure yet: free diving with bull sharks. Explore otherworldly Gulf Coast swamps filled with hungry alligators, crafty snapping turtles, and tiny but mighty beach mice who strengthen sand dunes.

programme.title: Deep Dive North America Season 1
programme.desc: Bundle up as Lizzie heads north to tag sharks and witness first-hand the slow, sobering disappearance of sea ice. Do time in bear jail with polar bears who are caught raiding a town for food after their icy hunting grounds diminish.

programme.title: Baby Animals - Prequel Season 1
programme.desc: Follow the staff at Parc Omega in Quebec, Canada, during the busy spring when moose, boars, raccoons, and visiting Canada geese have their babies.

programme.title: Secret Life of the Tasmanian Devil Season 1
programme.desc: Tasmanian Devils might have the most infamous reputations of any of the country's marsupials, but these spirited scrappers also have another side. They're committed parents and heroic defenders of their pouch-reared young.

programme.title: Big Cats, Small World Season 1
programme.desc: Track Molelo's pride, who are exhausted by cub care when the winter floods arrive. Check on the cheetah cubs, who make a difficult decision, and witness a scary encounter that makes leopard mum Sephiri choose between her old family and her new cubs.

programme.title: Mysteries of the Mekong Season 1
programme.desc: From manicured rice fields to wild tropical rainforests, the Mekong River is the source of life for eastern Thailand. Watch gibbons negotiate family dynamics, and see how the pit viper creates danger for the region's delicate living networks.

programme.title: Mysteries of the Mekong Season 1
programme.desc: Bisected by the Mekong's mighty waters, Cambodia is defined by its relationship to this great river. See why the country is a biodiversity hot spot and explore the secret refuges of animal populations that survive in its untouched natural habitats.

programme.title: Mysteries of the Mekong Season 1
programme.desc: The Mekong is Cambodia's lifeline, especially during the scorching dry season, when precious moisture is hard to come by. Learn how all manner of flying creatures, from birds to bats, manage resources until the rainy season brings sweet relief.

programme.title: Mysteries of the Mekong Season 1
programme.desc: The final country on the Mekong's journey is the home of the rivers mighty delta. A large deposit of rich nutrients carried downstream from hundreds of kilometres makes this region, the jewel of Vietnam's crown, a biological treasure trove.

programme.title: Mysteries of the Mekong Season 1
programme.desc: The Mekong Delta is one of the largest on Earth. Formed over the last 8000 years, it fans out and discharges into the South China Sea via nine channels. These channels split and shape the coastline, creating unique habitats for a variety of animals.

programme.title: Orangutan Jungle School Season 2
programme.desc: Watch a milestone moment when two students get their first forest time in years. And another pair of students are confined to the school's clinic after an accident in the forest leaves Beni with a broken leg and Lala with a broken elbow.

programme.title: Orangutan Jungle School Season 2
programme.desc: Beni and Lala are going stir crazy in the sick bay, but they must recover before returning to the rough and tumble of class. And at forest school, a termite-foraging lesson inspires class clown Valentino to make a finger-licking discovery.

programme.title: Orangutan Jungle School Season 2
programme.desc: Join two seriously ill orangutans in the medical clinic, where Erik's head infection is causing concern and fourteen-year-old Mia's life depends on a blood transfusion. Outside the clinic, the infants find a secret treat hidden inside a rubber tree.

programme.title: Orangutan Jungle School Season 2

programme.desc: Raisa (Baiti Syaghaf) discovers a shocking truth: her biological sister's fiancé is actually her own ex-boyfriend. programme.desc: Erika (Soraya Rasyid) gets separated from her group during a mountain hike and ends up completely lost. What does fate have in store for Erika?

programme.title: Jangan Spam Cinta di Hatiku
programme.desc: Mika has a handsome boyfriend, but his short-tempered nature constantly drives her crazy. On a rainy day, he blows up at her just because she refuses to get into the car, preferring to ride a motorcycle instead, which ends up ruining their travel plans. Fed up, Mika finally dumps him. Nursing her broken heart, she decides to dress up to the nines to look her absolute best post-breakup. That's when she is thrown into the path of a handsome cotton candy vendor. He immediately gets on her nerves...

programme.title: Cosplay Deket Kamu Cintanya No Play Play
programme.desc: To make ends meet and pay off her brother's mounting debts, Rana (Aylena Fusil) works daily as a roadside horror cosplayer. One day, she comes across Erza's (El Ryan Carlen) young nephew and decides to bring him home since Erza hasn't shown up to pick him up yet. However, when Erza finally arrives, he completely misunderstands the situation and accuses Rana of trying to kidnap the boy. How will this misunderstanding unfold?

programme.title: Bukan Cuma Khodam, Love Tester Kita Juga Cocok
programme.desc: Rani (Aylena Fusil) goes to the market to buy coconut milk from Aris (Masaji Wijayanto). Due to a classic misunderstanding, Aris thinks Rani hasn't paid yet and goes chasing after her to demand the money. Meanwhile, Rani's grandmother, desperate to see her granddaughter find the perfect match, consults a psychic to find out what kind of man is destined for Rani. What will happen next?

programme.title: 莫斯科行动
Moscow Mission
programme.desc: 根据1993年「中俄列车大劫案」的真实故事改编，讲述一群匪徒如何持械行劫，从过境列车中抢走现金及货物。一名伪装成商人的中国警察率领这次逮捕行动，当中却揭发另一个更庞大的阴谋…

programme.title: 向阳·花
We Girls
programme.desc: 为了给女儿购买价值二十万元的人工耳蜗，高月香铤而走险，最终被判入狱。意想不到的是，这段经历让她结识了三位女友人。她们虽然性格各异，却结下深厚情谊，携手迎难而上，互相扶持，共同向阳而生！

programme.title: 来福大酒店
Life Hotel
programme.desc: 曾经是街头混混的李清让，为了筹措父亲的心脏手术费，不断四处寻找工作。为了赚钱，他潜入来福大酒店，伪装成员工协助重建项目关闭酒店，却意外与住客们建立了深厚而真挚的感情。随着李清让发现这里其实是病友们的避风港，他不得不在责任感与同情心之间做出艰难抉择。

programme.title: 望月
Once in a Blue Moon
programme.desc: 美珍的家庭表面看似和睦，实则每个人都隐藏着秘密。美珍在工作中遭遇经理的无理对待，弟弟与妻子分居，却在家人面前假装恩爱，而母亲仍对多年前一件导致丈夫离去的事情感到遗憾。中秋将至，这一家人能否抚平伤口，重新检视家庭和团聚的真正意义？

programme.title: 谈判专家
Crisis Negotiators
programme.desc: 谈判专家卓文伟被陷害成杀警案的主脑，于是他冒着一切风险绑架警察，坚称要与前谈判专家谢家俊进行对话。在这场智力与心理的激烈对决中，两人的思维逐渐交错，展开了一场高智商的斗智斗力较量。

programme.title: 命中注定那头鹅
Penguin Girl
programme.desc: 月鹅钟爱阿德利企鹅，也深信真爱该如企鹅伴侣那般纯粹。当身穿企鹅装的何德利出现在她眼前时，她不禁思索，这是否就是命运安排的另一半。随着两人对未来的憧憬渐生迷惘，他们是否仍能如企鹅般成为忠诚的眷属？

programme.title: 流水落花
Lost Love
programme.desc: 为摆脱丧儿所带来的伤痛，天美成为寄养父母。十三年间，天美因醉心于照顾小孩而忽略丈夫的感受，甚至忘却了寄养孩子的真正需要。最终靠着寄养小孩有意无意的启发，才帮助夫妇二人挽回这段关系。

programme.title: 智齿
Limbo
programme.desc: 一宗凶残的连环杀人案震惊全港，经验丰富的警察斩哥与年轻督察任凯被委派调查此案。在调查过程中，他们遇到了王桃，并发现她意外害死了斩哥的妻子。为了赎回过失，王桃决定协助他们追捕连环杀手，却最终将自己置于极大的危险之中。

programme.title: 困兽
Death Stranding
programme.desc: 为了整顿已经纷乱不堪的地下博彩业，警方联合博彩协会展开打击地下赌场的严厉行动，并将新建赌场经营权以拍卖的形式处理，重新整顿博彩业。由于不一样的拍卖引发赌城风云变迁，不为人知的利益和秘密跟着被揭露，更引起各方人马的冲突…

programme.title: 破风
To the Fore
programme.desc: 天才单车手郑知元在队中担任冲线手，由王仇铭与丘田当他的「破风手」，为他制造冲线机会。二人明白破风手即使出色，亦只有冲线手一人能站上冠军台接受掌声。一场意外令三人分道扬镳，但一场赛事又让三人重遇 。到底谁能划破逆风，成为最终的王者？

programme.title: 重生
Go for Broke
programme.desc: 利欲熏心的贩毒集团不择手段，导致无数家庭因毒品而支离破碎，其中包括张耀的家庭。张耀决定要复仇，于是与缉毒队长安渡连手，计划剿灭毒贩首脑。然而，随着复仇计划开展，两人究竟是同仇敌忾，还是各怀鬼胎？

programme.title: 热辣滚烫
YOLO
programme.desc: 乐莹感到迷失和无所事事，在短暂的工作经历后，她选择退出社会。某天，经历了一连串意外事件后，她决定全新开始，拥抱生活的可能性。当她遇见一位拳击教练时，心中燃起了对新生活的希望。然而，随之而来的挑战却超出了她的想象，开启了她热血沸腾的人生旅程。

This pressured marriage becomes difficult for both Albi and Naza, as they were previously in love with other people.

programme.title: 他从火光中走来
Bright Eyes in the Dark
programme.desc: 林陆骁拥有过人的消防技巧和丰富的消防经验，是北浔市特勤一站站长。因缘际会下，他被选中成了一档旨在科普消防知识的真人节目的教官。在节目中林陆骁偶遇自己多年前从火场中救下的舞蹈演员南初。南初对林陆骁充满好感，但林陆骁却因深知自己职业的危险而不愿靠近。年轻而勇敢的新一代消防员如邵一九、秦十全等崭露头角，从国外带回先进装备技术的楼明冶也回到了消防队。老中青三代消防员们在火灾、地震、空中救援等灾情救援中通力合作，将北浔市的消防安全水平提升了一个台阶。南初与林陆骁也在逐渐深入了解中确定了自己的心意，面临最危险的森林火灾，林陆骁与他的队友们依然选择逆火前进。

programme.desc: 《乡野有真味第三季》将镜头投向中国南方的隐秘角落——广东、广西、浙江、福建、湖南、江西、安徽、贵州八省，深入竹林溪涧、古村深巷，探访那些颠覆味蕾认知的“暗黑”美食与新奇风味，揭开乡土食材与地域文化交织的味觉密码。“Country Roads Delicious Food S3” turns to the hidden corners of southern China, the eight provinces of Guangdong, Guangxi, Zhejiang, Fujian, Hunan, Jiangxi, Anhui and Guizhou. programme.title: 大泼猴

programme.desc:

A mortal man accidentally time-travels to the past and becomes the Monkey King. Unwilling to accept his fate, he embarks on a journey that brings him to face gods and demons.

programme.desc: 1916年，褚韶华为救哥哥而嫁给陈记药铺大少爷陈大顺，她以诚信和出色的商业得到陈父的赏识，成为药铺管理人。陈父和陈大顺意外去世后，陈二顺继承药铺并败光家财，药铺陷入绝境。褚韶华在艰辛努力下，开了华顺药铺养活一家老小。褚韶华后决意携手初恋情人夏初开启新生活，却遭陈二顺和陈母阻挠。陈家被土匪洗劫一空，褚韶华也在这次劫难中失去女儿，伤心不已的她独自出走上海。褚韶华在上海永新百货业绩突出，受经营奇才闻知秋之邀共同创业，逐步成长为胆略过人、重诺守信的女商人。This is the story of Chu, who came from a family of traditional Chinese medicine in the early years of China and her life revolving round three men - Xia Chu, Chen Da Shun, and Wen Zhi Qiu. Not succumbing to the unfair arrangements of the times and fate, Chu gradually ex...

programme.title: 他从火光中走来
Bright Eyes in the Dark
programme.desc: 林陆骁拥有过人的消防技巧和丰富的消防经验，是北浔市特勤一站站长。因缘际会下，他被选中成了一档旨在科普消防知识的真人节目的教官。在节目中林陆骁偶遇自己多年前从火场中救下的舞蹈演员南初。南初对林陆骁充满好感，但林陆骁却因深知自己职业的危险而不愿靠近。年轻而勇敢的新一代消防员如邵一九、秦十全等崭露头角，从国外带回先进装备技术的楼明冶也回到了消防队。老中青三代消防员们在火灾、地震、空中救援等灾情救援中通力合作，将北浔市的消防安全水平提升了一个台阶。南初与林陆骁也在逐渐深入了解中确定了自己的心意，面临最危险的森林火灾，林陆骁与他的队友们依然选择逆火前进。

programme.desc: 她是一个再普通不过的女人，有着一份薪水微薄的工作，一个沉默寡言的丈夫。她以为自己永远普通，直到有一天晚上，厄运猛然降临，她开始活在黑暗里。她怕有人说她那天晚上出席酒局，也怕有人说她那天晚上穿了裙子。她怕丈夫指责她不贞，也怕家人辱骂她败德。直到一切无法隐藏，她一贯寡言的丈夫坐在沙发上，抽完了最后一根烟，看向蜷缩在角落里哭得不成样子的她。然后他拉着她的手，报警，追凶，上诉。用余生和性命，去为她求一个公道，要一份天理，给一份爱。An ordinary woman with an ordinary life and an ordinary husband. Until one night, her husband forgot to pick her up at the wine party she was attending, leading to her being raped. But because she was afraid to be blamed for getting drunk, to be blamed for having worn a dress, to be ...

programme.title: 翘楚
Ashes to Crown
programme.desc: 将军之女楚朝为改变自己成为楚国世子萧珣夺权路上牺牲品的可悲命运，发现主动出击才是改变命运的唯一途径。在与命运一波三折的对抗中，她与谢家庶子谢燕来相识，并点亮了谢燕来原本灰暗的人生，助谢燕来挣脱命运枷锁，从禁军小卒成长为镇国大将军。楚朝与谢燕来合力成功阻止了世子的野心和计划，在本该逃离是非之地的途中，见到战火中百姓的苦难，楚朝毅然返回城内，助力小皇孙萧羽为帝，直至萧羽亲政。然而萧珣又引外敌来犯，为权欲不惜陷万民于水火。楚朝携手谢燕来与之殊死抵抗，领军浴血奋战，终于成功解除大楚内忧外患。至此，楚朝不仅改变了自己的命运，也让大楚千千万万百姓摆脱了战火离乱的颠沛命运。Reborn before her fateful marriage, General's daughter Chu Chao vows to avert her family's tragic doom. She secures the throne for the young heir, earning the title of Grand Princess. When foreign forces invade, Ch...

programme.title: 在暴雪时分
Amidst a Snowstorm of Love
programme.desc: 昔日天才级职业斯诺克选手林亦扬与当红九球选手殷果相遇在一场十年难得一遇的暴雪之夜。在殷果表弟的助攻之下，两人慢慢熟识。殷果也了解到林亦扬的往事。原来林亦扬曾经也是轰动一时的斯诺克天才，在一次比赛中因对裁判判罚有异议，争取时无意冲撞裁判而被禁赛，少年气盛的他不服判决，竟直接宣布退役，从此离开了自己引以为傲的斯诺克事业。殷果的出现，让林亦扬的人生轨迹再次转变，林亦扬不仅开始努力地追求殷果，还在殷果的带动下重拾最初的梦想，返回斯诺克赛场。最终二人共攀事业高峰，一同为职业台球事业贡献力量，并携手教练与队友，共推全民健身台球项目发展。

programme.title: 祈今朝
Sword and Fairy
programme.desc: 越今朝和越祈二人在乌岩村相伴三年，有着神奇的“共鸣”关系，却对各自的身世一无所知。二人携手闯荡江湖，希望找回过往记忆。双越二人被卷入启魂圣宗作乱和洛家堡血祭等神秘事件之中，而在对抗圣宗过程中意外让越祈被封印的回忆和情感被开启。随着事件发展，双越结识了洛家堡双子洛埋名和洛昭言、千年狼妖闲卿、顾寒江和明绣师徒以及居十方等江湖人士，二人的真实身份也逐渐揭开。

programme.desc: 昔日天才级职业斯诺克选手林亦扬与当红九球选手殷果相遇在一场十年难得一遇的暴雪之夜。在殷果表弟的助攻之下，两人慢慢熟识。殷果也了解到林亦扬的往事。原来林亦扬曾经也是轰动一时的斯诺克天才，在一次比赛中因对裁判判罚有异议，争取时无意冲撞裁判而被禁赛，少年气盛的他不服判决，竟直接宣布退役，从此离开了自己引以为傲的斯诺克事业。殷果的出现，让林亦扬的人生轨迹再次转变，林亦扬不仅开始努力地追求殷果，还在殷果的带动下重拾最初的梦想，返回斯诺克赛场。最终二人共攀事业高峰，一同为职业台球事业贡献力量，并携手教练与队友，共推全民健身台球项目发展。

programme.title: 祈今朝
Sword and Fairy
programme.desc: 越今朝和越祈二人在乌岩村相伴三年，有着神奇的“共鸣”关系，却对各自的身世一无所知。二人携手闯荡江湖，希望找回过往记忆。双越二人被卷入启魂圣宗作乱和洛家堡血祭等神秘事件之中，而在对抗圣宗过程中意外让越祈被封印的回忆和情感被开启。随着事件发展，双越结识了洛家堡双子洛埋名和洛昭言、千年狼妖闲卿、顾寒江和明绣师徒以及居十方等江湖人士，二人的真实身份也逐渐揭开。

programme.title: Secrets of the Enchanted Waters Season 1
programme.desc: Venture along Earth's coasts, where colliding worlds create a melting pot of biodiversity. Watch orcas hunt with precision, hold on as guillemot chicks take leaps of faith, crawl to safety with turtle hatchlings, and see crabs sculpt sandy galaxies.

programme.title: Secrets of the Enchanted Waters Season 1
programme.desc: Trace dazzling waterways all over the world, from volcanic rivers in Russia's far east to geothermal streams in Florida. Watch as beavers transform entire landscapes with their well-engineered dams, then enjoy a winter spa day with manatees.

programme.title: Secrets of the Enchanted Waters Season 1
programme.desc: Journey through mystical lakes, where life adapts, survives, and transforms. Witness the power of ancient beasts like the snapping turtle, watch a dragonfly metamorphosis, and walk tall with flamingoes as they brave burning, corrosive waters.

programme.title: Secrets of the Enchanted Waters Season 1
programme.desc: Unmask the eerie beauty of swamplands, which have inspired centuries of folklore and serve as a vital link between life and death. Swim with hungry crocodiles, see deer gamble with their lives for food, and watch carnivorous plants snap up prey.

programme.title: Secrets of the Enchanted Waters Season 1
programme.desc: Freeze time as water becomes a force of change in Earth's most frigid ecosystems. Hunt for unsuspecting seals with polar bears, bathe in natural hot springs with macaques, and try out a unique survival strategy with Arctic foxes.

programme.title: The Ocean's Greatest Feast
programme.desc: Get a front-row seat to the planet's biggest biomass migration, the annual 1,000-mile sardine run along South Africa's east coast. See billions of these tiny fish run a gauntlet of hungry predators, including stealthy seals and dive-bombing gannets.

programme.title: Wild Dogs: Pack vs. Pride Season 2
programme.desc: Return to South Luangwa to see the new pups born to the mighty Manzi and the tiny-but-fearless Kakumbi packs. See yearling Snowy face a hungry hyena before a lion pride scatters Manzi mum Weka's pups and leaves her frantically searching for them.

programme.title: Africa's Wild Year Season 1
programme.desc: Autumn in Africa brings opportunities. Cape Fur seals, Samango monkeys, chameleons, impala, and more respond to the season. Autumn triggers changes in the lives of many animals. Rare creatures reveal themselves and predators gather to take advantage.

programme.title: Africa's Wild Year Season 1
programme.desc: Be an eyewitness to the death and resurrection that winter brings to Africa. Observe what comes with shorter days, from drought conditions to frigid winds, and marvel at the survival skills of animals and plants as they face the season's fury.

programme.title: Superbeast Season 1
programme.desc: Bow down to one of nature's most ancient and deadly endurance predators. Watch tiger sharks exploit turtle nesting chaos, survive oxygen-poor environments with epaulette sharks, and withstand the crushing pressure of the deep with ghost sharks.

programme.title: Africa's Hunters Season 3
programme.desc: As the lionesses set out to recover the males who are needed to hunt buffalo, they must cross a crocodile-infested river. Follow Milo, the only cub in the mighty Mwamba pride, as he's saved from snapping jaws and cements the family's future.

programme.title: Africa's Hunters Season 3
programme.desc: If the tiny Nsefu pride is to survive, the teen Misfit and his older brother must quickly perfect their hunting skills. Trek into enemy territory as the lions face dominant rivals and a powerful hyena clan in the search for prey.

programme.title: Big Cat Country Season 1
programme.desc: The all-female Hollywood pride have been in exile after being attacked by the four Nomad brothers. But their leader, Ava, decides to lead her family south to the heart of their territory for a showdown with the Nomads.

programme.title: Orangutan Jungle School Season 2
programme.desc: The race is on to find Tulia and Zalipa, who are missing from Palas Island. And after months of convalescence, Beni returns to forest school but faces another setback at the milk bucket. Meanwhile, the vets keep a close eye on pregnant Dilla.

programme.title: 風華合伙人
Lifestyle Lab
programme.desc: 由吳彥祖擔任「風華投資人」，集結井朧、代旭、沙一汀、周柯宇、常華森、董思成、謝依霖等常駐嘉賓，在杭州西湖邊的青春潮飲生活店，共同完成15天的運營任務，探索興趣社交的潮流生活方式。

programme.title: 半熟戀人 第4季
Love Actually Season 4 (Repackaged)
programme.desc: 30+的素人嘉賓們帶著成熟與期待，在摩登都市上海入住郊區小屋，從陌生到熟悉，從心動到堅定，共同開啟一段30天的尋愛之旅；除了元老嘉賓謝楠、張純燁、唐藝昕之外，更邀請了徐藝洋和顏安等組成「半熟觀察員」，一同見證高甜瞬間。

programme.title: 點贊！達人秀
Talent
programme.desc: 全民才藝真人秀節目，圍繞主題聚焦不同類型達人進行同主題表演；邀請了謝霆鋒、鄧紫棋、孟非、伊能靜組成「觀察團」，從各自的專業知識與觀察視角出發，深入百姓生活，挖掘值得點贊的才藝與故事。

programme.title: 遊遍江蘇 第4季
Travel through Jiangsu Season 4
programme.desc: 遊遍江蘇全省的名勝古蹟和大街小巷，尋訪文史學家、學者，走訪民間藝人工匠等，探尋風景背後的動人故事，深度觸摸江蘇的文化脈搏，帶領大家發現江蘇的獨特魅力。

programme.title: 一拍即合的我們
Hit It Off
programme.desc: 一檔演員搭檔研習進階真人秀，由關錦鵬、吳鎮宇、許鞍華擔當“研習制作人”，參與研習階段任務、監制和拍攝作品，蘇可擔任“研習指導”，陳喬恩、謝娜、李維嘉、吳昕作為“研習助力團”；十多位參與的青年演員，通過共同的生活和訓練，共同開啟尋找搭檔的研習生活。

programme.title: 音樂緣計劃
Melody Journey (Repackaged)
programme.desc: 首檔原創音樂創演節目，邀請了薛之謙、張靚穎、周深、單依純、黃子弘凡等歌手，同時更邀請小柯、方文山、黃國倫等樂壇前輩和眾多新生代原創音樂人加盟；由歌曲爭奪戰、首演舞台兩大核心環節組成，用一場歌手與歌曲的奇遇，為他們提供一個自由共創的舞台，打造華語樂壇新的高光時刻。

programme.title: 緣來不晚 第4季
Love Never Comes Late Season 4
programme.desc: 專為資深單身人士定制的相親交友節目，每集有4位男嘉賓和3位女嘉賓，依序進行一對一交流。未上場嘉賓則分別在男女嘉賓室觀察場上溝通情況，加深對有意對象的瞭解。節目主張為愛回歸，愛情不分年齡，緣來從來不晚。

programme.title: 音樂緣計劃 第2季
Crush of Music Season 2 (Repackaged)
programme.desc: 將繼續以「音樂牽線，緣分發聲」為主題，賽制上進行了全面創新升級，帶來更具懸念的緣分匹配設定、更多元的趣味互動模式，以及更動人的團隊默契考驗；匯聚周深、薛之謙、單依純等10位實力歌手與新銳音樂人，通過盲選歌單、即興創作等環碰撞靈感，打造專屬合作舞台！

programme.title: 職來職往2026
Job Match 2026
programme.desc: 打破傳統求職單向選擇的邏輯，從企業「滅燈挑錯」的評判模式，升級為發掘求職者自身閃光點的賦能模式。企業面試官可以隨時爆燈拋出橄欖枝，同步明確崗位與薪酬待遇，大幅拓寬求職者的選擇空間，讓雙向匹配更高效、更真誠。

programme.title: 非正式會談 第8季
Informal Talks Season 8
programme.desc: 一檔外國人用中文搞事情的文化訪談類節目，由4名主席團成員大左、楊迪、陳銘及陳超，1名飛行嘉賓與10名不同國家的青年代表聚集在一起，以詼諧態度和調侃精神，增進中國與世界文化的交流，圍繞社會話題及各國風俗文化進行討論。

programme.title: 與君渡長歡 (短劇)
Eternal Joy With You (Mini drama)
programme.desc: 藥商之女許婉寧前世遭丈夫背叛、親生骨肉被害，含恨重生；為了守護孩子並復仇，她與調查禁藥的金鱗衛大督主裴珩結盟，兩人從互有成見的試探，到相知相許的聯手，不僅粉碎了危害朝政的驚天陰謀，更在夢境與現實的交錯中，讓女主重獲自救的勇氣，開啟了全新人生。

programme.title: 夙夜集 (短劇)
The Rebirth (Mini drama)
programme.desc: 蒼梧國大將軍之女羲和遭滅門及暗算，重生為廢柴嫡女沈千夜。她懷著滿腔不甘踏上復仇之路，與疑似凶手的「小皇叔」裴夙糾纏不休。在調查真相的過程中，兩人從相互算計到聯手抗敵，揭開了蒼梧國隱藏的重重秘密。

programme.title: 宇宙閃爍請注意
Wander Together
programme.desc: 重磅打造的全明星爆笑旅行遊戲真人秀，由黃曉明、黃子韜、劉耀文、邵子恆、王鶴棣、于洋組成「宇宙爆閃團」，用高能抽象任務，打造解壓式快樂體驗，去有趣的地方做有意義的事；放下偶像包袱，發送獨一無二的快樂訊號。

programme.title: 極限挑戰 第十季
Go Fighting! Season 10 (Repackaged)
programme.desc: 「極挑團」原班人馬將與新成員一起解鎖更多挑戰，他們將與廣大觀眾一起跨越大江南北，體驗國民生活百態，用真心探訪這片古老土地上正在發生的溫情故事，以更豐富的視角觸摸這卷山河下每一位個體的對美好生活的深切期望。

programme.desc: 本集融融和咪蕾来到庆州的骨窟寺体验当下韩国年轻人最喜欢的TEMPLE STAY沿着山径一步步往上岩壁与石佛静静伫立千年修行的气息在空气中流动让人不自觉放慢脚步两人更参与庙中的108拜禅武道等两天一夜活动 离开古刹后跟着咪蕾回到她熟悉的家拜访妈妈与哥哥一同制作团圆必吃的散炙还体验少见的古式汗蒸幕以柴火升温石室发汗在热气与汗水中感受最贴近土地的疗愈方式 接着来到海港向渔民购买最新鲜的生鱼片简单切盘就能吃出海水的清甜最后来到全罗北道蟾津江最有名的河螺村卷起袖子走进河边亲手抓河螺再回到厨房熬煮成暖胃的解酒汤剩下的河螺则化身为香气四溢的煎饼外酥内嫩 从山林古寺在地人家到港口与河岸这趟旅程不只是看风景更是走进韩国日常用身体与味觉细细感受生活本来的样子

programme.title: 饭戏攻心2

programme.desc: 这是《饭戏攻心》的续集，讲述二哥和三哥在大哥离家之际，计划要结婚。最后，他们的婚宴成为一个混乱的战场，婚宴升级为家族斗兽场，造成一场喜上加喜的饭戏！

programme.title: 人约离婚后
Love is the only Answer
programme.desc: 在宝和强的婚宴上，投影机原本正播着他们相恋过程，突然画面闪出强跟性感女子的做爱片段宝冷静地走到台上宣布离婚并将婚礼实时取消，这件事迅速成为网上热话。一年来，回复单身的宝与风流快活强继续保持友好关系，一天烂滚爱玩的强竟带宝参加换妻派对，保守的宝本想离开，但遭强威迫利诱下无奈参与。在换妻派对上，两人遇上杰与妻子曼丽，四人发展出浪漫而火辣的关系...这边厢，在另一个婚宴上当投影机又是播着新郎与新娘的温馨片段时，画面又闪出意想不到...

programme.title: 峰爆
Cloudy Mountain

programme.title: 西游记·女儿国

programme.title: 不说话的爱
MuMu
programme.desc: 木木是一名开朗的七岁女孩，与失聪的父亲小马一同生活在聋人小区中。她是父亲与外界沟通的唯一桥梁。然而，当失散多年的母亲突然出现时，他们平静的生活被打扰，木木也被迫进入听人的世界。与此同时，小马却遭到犯罪集团的诱骗，意外卷入一个专门利用聋人从事犯罪的陷阱中。

programme.title: 手卷烟

programme.title: 窗前明月，咣！

programme.title: CAHAYA CINTA AZZURA 1
programme.desc: Cahaya is a beautiful young woman who works at a fish farm owned by Adipura, a wealthy businessman in a village in Sukabumi. One day, Cahaya's father is involved in an accident and is hospitalized. Desperate to find money for his treatment, Cahaya turns to Adipura for help. Adipura agrees, but on one condition: Cahaya must marry him.

programme.title: SAYAP CINTA TERINDAH EPS 30
programme.desc: It tells the story of Dhani, the firm and responsible eldest son, as he strives to take care of his three younger siblings (David, Ariel, and Isyana) in order to fulfill their father Haris's dream of having a harmonious family. Dhani carries a heavy burden, but he faces serious challenges as his siblings resent him and each of them harbors their own complicated secrets.

programme.title: CINTA SEPENUH JIWA EPS 134
programme.desc: Lala is a young girl, the second daughter of Andi and Desi, who since childhood has carried enthusiasm and a smile with her every step. Her life is simple but full of color thanks to one thing she truly loves: cooking. For Lala, the kitchen is not just a place to prepare ingredients. It is a space for expression, a place where she pours out her emotions, wraps stories into every seasoning, and serves love through every dish. With the support of Hasbi—her boyfriend who later becomes her husban...

programme.title: CAHAYA TERINDAH EPS 61
programme.desc: A drama series that tells the story of Indah (Ranty Maria) and her struggle to find her biological family after discovering that she was adopted. She runs away to Jakarta from her adoptive father (Jamal), who intends to sell her, and ends up working for the Hendardi family, where she faces romantic conflicts and emotional mysteries from her past.

programme.title: TURUN RANJANG EPS 31
programme.desc: Albi (Samuel Zylgwyn) is forced to marry his sister-in-law, Naza (Rachquel Nesia), at the request of his father-in-law, Wira. This decision is made for the sake of caring for baby Zia (Faradilla Yoshi), Albi's wife, who falls into a coma after giving birth. This pressured marriage becomes difficult for both Albi and Naza, as they were previously in love with other people.

programme.title: TERIKAT JANJI EPS 31
programme.desc: A drama series that tells the story of Davina, a conglomerate's daughter who falls into poverty after being betrayed. She is forced to pretend to be in a relationship with Sena, a ketoprak street vendor. This fake relationship, meant to protect her reputation, becomes complicated when Sena is actually an undercover intelligence agent on a mission tied to his past—further intensified by conflicts involving a stepmother and past betrayals.

programme.title: CINTA BERAKHIR BAHAGIA 105
programme.desc: Adisty, a beautiful young woman who serves as the backbone of her family, nearly becomes a sex worker to pay off her family's debts. However, fate brings her together with Pasha, a respectable man from a wealthy family. Unbeknownst to them, they were actually switched at birth. What will happen to Adisty and Pasha's lives?

programme.title: 利剑.玫瑰
Sword Rose
programme.desc: 一心想要查找缉毒警察男友死亡真相的女警花邓妍，在一次解救人质的意外行动中大放异彩，被调到打拐办任代理主任。邓妍通过缜密的推理、精准的判断力以及奋不顾身的行动，让原本持怀疑态度的同事变为钦佩和坚定支持。面对罪犯的狡猾和凶残，邓妍与同事们共同努力，剥茧抽丝，终将拐卖妇女儿童犯罪团伙的一个个犯罪嫌疑人绳之以法。与此同时，男友被害的真相也渐渐浮出水面。Police officer Hua Deng Yan hopes to join the anti-drug team to find out the truth behind her boyfriend's death. However, she shines during an unexpected operation which earns her a promotion to the acting director of the anti-trafficking team. Hua Deng Yan becomes part of the six-member anti-trafficking team that pits wit...

programme.title: 因 AI 相约
AI Romance
programme.desc: 由袁成杰、余有矿主持，心理咨询师于志凌坐镇的《因AI相约》，是中国首创全新相亲综艺。让AI红娘登场，牵起缘分的红线，用AI独家大数据模型，精准捕捉嘉宾个性，再用AI面具盲选，真诚交流点燃心动瞬间。到底是选择AI推荐，还是倾听内心声音？《因AI相约》用算法助力情缘，让爱情见证最美的邂逅！ “AI Romance” is a dating variety with a spin, marrying scientific AI technology with age-old romance and love! This is China’s first attempt at artificial intelligence experimental dating series and the programme brings on a whole new viewing experience and refreshed feel, for traditional dating varieties.

programme.title: 两岸一味第一季&第二季
The Flavourful Link Across the Strait S1 & S2
programme.desc: 以街头巷尾的民间味道为联结，追溯两岸美食的中华渊源，讲述两岸故事，共鸣情感与文化。六大主题版块，30种两岸吃食，60组人文故事，用两岸一脉共生的食之味，展现两岸一根同源的人情味，讲述两岸饮食的人间烟火，追寻中华民族的味觉乡愁。

programme.title: 淮水竹亭
Love in Pavilion
programme.desc: 《淮水竹亭》是《狐妖小红娘》的第二部曲，讲述了在人妖势不两立的局势下，两大家族东方家和王权家的掌舵人东方淮竹和王权弘业为了重振一气盟，共同努力安定局势的故事。The second installment of the popular “Fox Spirit Matchmaker” series – “Love in Pavilion” depicts the story of Dongfang Huaizhu and Wangquan Hongye, leaders of the two major families, Dongfang and Wangquan. In a time when humans and demons are in conflict, they work together to stabilize the situation to revive the Unity Alliance. On the seventh day of the seventh month, at the Bamboo Pavilion by the Huai River, th...

programme.title: 灼灼韶华
Wild Ambition Bloom
programme.desc: 1916年，褚韶华为救哥哥而嫁给陈记药铺大少爷陈大顺，她以诚信和出色的商业得到陈父的赏识，成为药铺管理人。陈父和陈大顺意外去世后，陈二顺继承药铺并败光家财，药铺陷入绝境。褚韶华在艰辛努力下，开了华顺药铺养活一家老小。褚韶华后决意携手初恋情人夏初开启新生活，却遭陈二顺和陈母阻挠。陈家被土匪洗劫一空，褚韶华也在这次劫难中失去女儿，伤心不已的她独自出走上海。褚韶华在上海永新百货业绩突出，受经营奇才闻知秋之邀共同创业，逐步成长为胆略过人、重诺守信的女商人。This is the story of Chu, who came from a family of traditional Chinese medicine in the early years of China and her life revolving round three men - Xia Chu, Chen Da Shun, and Wen Zhi Qiu. Not succumbing to the unfair arrangements of the times and fate, Chu gradually ex...

programme.title: 他从火光中走来
Bright Eyes in the Dark
programme.desc: 林陆骁拥有过人的消防技巧和丰富的消防经验，是北浔市特勤一站站长。因缘际会下，他被选中成了一档旨在科普消防知识的真人节目的教官。在节目中林陆骁偶遇自己多年前从火场中救下的舞蹈演员南初。南初对林陆骁充满好感，但林陆骁却因深知自己职业的危险而不愿靠近。年轻而勇敢的新一代消防员如邵一九、秦十全等崭露头角，从国外带回先进装备技术的楼明冶也回到了消防队。老中青三代消防员们在火灾、地震、空中救援等灾情救援中通力合作，将北浔市的消防安全水平提升了一个台阶。南初与林陆骁也在逐渐深入了解中确定了自己的心意，面临最危险的森林火灾，林陆骁与他的队友们依然选择逆火前进。

programme.title: 大泼猴
The Legends Of Monkey King
programme.desc:
天道变数，石妖提前三百年破石而出，生存堪忧的石妖踏上了寻仙之路。他在求仙路上九死一生，幸得金丝雀舍命相救，石妖因此许下了复活金丝雀的诺言。为了实现诺言，石妖一路拜师修行，其间与天真烂漫的风铃和孤傲高冷的杨岚分别暗生情愫，还卷入了众妖与天庭的对抗之中。
A mortal man accidentally time-travels to the past and becomes the Monkey King. Unwilling to accept his fate, he embarks on a journey that brings him to face gods and demons.

programme.desc: 一心想要查找缉毒警察男友死亡真相的女警花邓妍，在一次解救人质的意外行动中大放异彩，被调到打拐办任代理主任。邓妍通过缜密的推理、精准的判断力以及奋不顾身的行动，让原本持怀疑态度的同事变为钦佩和坚定支持。面对罪犯的狡猾和凶残，邓妍与同事们共同努力，剥茧抽丝，终将拐卖妇女儿童犯罪团伙的一个个犯罪嫌疑人绳之以法。与此同时，男友被害的真相也渐渐浮出水面。Police officer Hua Deng Yan hopes to join the anti-drug team to find out the truth behind her boyfriend's death. 徐冬熙梦想成为服装设计师，一场突如其来的意外，却让她必须领养侄子成为了单亲妈妈，多亏家人及邻居协助，让她在照顾侄子之余仍得以重拾曾经放弃的梦想。姜次烈则年幼时父亲去世，其后被叔叔收养，虽曾有彷徨时期，但他头脑聪明、成绩和外貌出众，可是他做的越好，哥哥和妈妈的表情就越冷淡。为了迎合母亲的喜好，次烈无法凭自己的意愿生活，虽然不想继承家族企业却被安排进入公司工作，虽不开心但也只能等着离开这个家独立的日子…

Love in Pavilion

programme.title: 他从火光中走来
Bright Eyes in the Dark
programme.desc: 林陆骁拥有过人的消防技巧和丰富的消防经验，是北浔市特勤一站站长。因缘际会下，他被选中成了一档旨在科普消防知识的真人节目的教官。在节目中林陆骁偶遇自己多年前从火场中救下的舞蹈演员南初。南初对林陆骁充满好感，但林陆骁却因深知自己职业的危险而不愿靠近。年轻而勇敢的新一代消防员如邵一九、秦十全等崭露头角，从国外带回先进装备技术的楼明冶也回到了消防队。老中青三代消防员们在火灾、地震、空中救援等灾情救援中通力合作，将北浔市的消防安全水平提升了一个台阶。南初与林陆骁也在逐渐深入了解中确定了自己的心意，面临最危险的森林火灾，林陆骁与他的队友们依然选择逆火前进。

programme.title: 灼灼韶华
Wild Ambition Bloom
programme.desc: 1916年，褚韶华为救哥哥而嫁给陈记药铺大少爷陈大顺，她以诚信和出色的商业得到陈父的赏识，成为药铺管理人。陈父和陈大顺意外去世后，陈二顺继承药铺并败光家财，药铺陷入绝境。褚韶华在艰辛努力下，开了华顺药铺养活一家老小。褚韶华后决意携手初恋情人夏初开启新生活，却遭陈二顺和陈母阻挠。陈家被土匪洗劫一空，褚韶华也在这次劫难中失去女儿，伤心不已的她独自出走上海。褚韶华在上海永新百货业绩突出，受经营奇才闻知秋之邀共同创业，逐步成长为胆略过人、重诺守信的女商人。This is the story of Chu, who came from a family of traditional Chinese medicine in the early years of China and her life revolving round three men - Xia Chu, Chen Da Shun, and Wen Zhi Qiu. Not succumbing to the unfair arrangements of the times and fate, Chu gradually ex...

programme.title: 嗨放派 3
Have Fun Season 3
programme.desc: 《嗨放派》是一档奇趣实验类真人秀综艺节目，第三季主打真实的生存实验，六位艺人嘉宾将开启十天荒岛生存挑战，比如需要自食其力体验搭建帐篷、自制淋浴间、起火烧饭、自制做饭器具等挑战，最后还要举行一场别开生面的海岛运动会，用最好玩的方式将科学实践到生活里头。 “Have Fun” returns for a third season! The very well-received China variety again sees six popular male artistes teaming up to escape the constraints and pressures of city life and having fun through exploring interesting scientific topics and real-life Science experiments, this time on a remote island looking for survival!

programme.title: 勇敢无双龙秀晶
The Brave Yong Su Jeong
programme.desc: 该剧为一部浪漫复仇剧，讲述了梦想成为现代版巨商林尚玉的女子龙秀晶与将命运托付给她的吝啬鬼绝症患者吕义柱相遇后，两人共同展开复仇的故事。剧中还涉及与财阀家族相关的出生秘密等人物关系。Yong Su-Jeong is a popular but shy-in-love host who has a crush on a rich heir, Joo Woo-Jin, while hardworking Yeo Ui-Joo’s life changes when he discovers he’s also part of the same wealthy family.

programme.title: 祈今朝
Sword and Fairy
programme.desc: 越今朝和越祈二人在乌岩村相伴三年，有着神奇的“共鸣”关系，却对各自的身世一无所知。二人携手闯荡江湖，希望找回过往记忆。双越二人被卷入启魂圣宗作乱和洛家堡血祭等神秘事件之中，而在对抗圣宗过程中意外让越祈被封印的回忆和情感被开启。随着事件发展，双越结识了洛家堡双子洛埋名和洛昭言、千年狼妖闲卿、顾寒江和明绣师徒以及居十方等江湖人士，二人的真实身份也逐渐揭开。

programme.title: 余生有涯
Light Beyond the Reed
programme.desc: 她是一个再普通不过的女人，有着一份薪水微薄的工作，一个沉默寡言的丈夫。她以为自己永远普通，直到有一天晚上，厄运猛然降临，她开始活在黑暗里。她怕有人说她那天晚上出席酒局，也怕有人说她那天晚上穿了裙子。她怕丈夫指责她不贞，也怕家人辱骂她败德。直到一切无法隐藏，她一贯寡言的丈夫坐在沙发上，抽完了最后一根烟，看向蜷缩在角落里哭得不成样子的她。然后他拉着她的手，报警，追凶，上诉。用余生和性命，去为她求一个公道，要一份天理，给一份爱。An ordinary woman with an ordinary life and an ordinary husband. Until one night, her husband forgot to pick her up at the wine party she was attending, leading to her being raped. But because she was afraid to be blamed for getting drunk, to be blamed for having worn a dress, to be ...

programme.title: 翘楚
Ashes to Crown
programme.desc: 将军之女楚朝为改变自己成为楚国世子萧珣夺权路上牺牲品的可悲命运，发现主动出击才是改变命运的唯一途径。在与命运一波三折的对抗中，她与谢家庶子谢燕来相识，并点亮了谢燕来原本灰暗的人生，助谢燕来挣脱命运枷锁，从禁军小卒成长为镇国大将军。楚朝与谢燕来合力成功阻止了世子的野心和计划，在本该逃离是非之地的途中，见到战火中百姓的苦难，楚朝毅然返回城内，助力小皇孙萧羽为帝，直至萧羽亲政。然而萧珣又引外敌来犯，为权欲不惜陷万民于水火。楚朝携手谢燕来与之殊死抵抗，领军浴血奋战，终于成功解除大楚内忧外患。至此，楚朝不仅改变了自己的命运，也让大楚千千万万百姓摆脱了战火离乱的颠沛命运。Reborn before her fateful marriage, General's daughter Chu Chao vows to avert her family's tragic doom. programme.title: 在暴雪时分
Amidst a Snowstorm of Love
programme.desc: 昔日天才级职业斯诺克选手林亦扬与当红九球选手殷果相遇在一场十年难得一遇的暴雪之夜。在殷果表弟的助攻之下，两人慢慢熟识。殷果也了解到林亦扬的往事。原来林亦扬曾经也是轰动一时的斯诺克天才，在一次比赛中因对裁判判罚有异议，争取时无意冲撞裁判而被禁赛，少年气盛的他不服判决，竟直接宣布退役，从此离开了自己引以为傲的斯诺克事业。殷果的出现，让林亦扬的人生轨迹再次转变，林亦扬不仅开始努力地追求殷果，还在殷果的带动下重拾最初的梦想，返回斯诺克赛场。最终二人共攀事业高峰，一同为职业台球事业贡献力量，并携手教练与队友，共推全民健身台球项目发展。

programme.title: 在暴雪时分
Amidst a Snowstorm of Love
programme.desc: 昔日天才级职业斯诺克选手林亦扬与当红九球选手殷果相遇在一场十年难得一遇的暴雪之夜。在殷果表弟的助攻之下，两人慢慢熟识。殷果也了解到林亦扬的往事。原来林亦扬曾经也是轰动一时的斯诺克天才，在一次比赛中因对裁判判罚有异议，争取时无意冲撞裁判而被禁赛，少年气盛的他不服判决，竟直接宣布退役，从此离开了自己引以为傲的斯诺克事业。殷果的出现，让林亦扬的人生轨迹再次转变，林亦扬不仅开始努力地追求殷果，还在殷果的带动下重拾最初的梦想，返回斯诺克赛场。最终二人共攀事业高峰，一同为职业台球事业贡献力量，并携手教练与队友，共推全民健身台球项目发展。

programme.title: 祈今朝
Sword and Fairy
programme.desc: 越今朝和越祈二人在乌岩村相伴三年，有着神奇的“共鸣”关系，却对各自的身世一无所知。二人携手闯荡江湖，希望找回过往记忆。双越二人被卷入启魂圣宗作乱和洛家堡血祭等神秘事件之中，而在对抗圣宗过程中意外让越祈被封印的回忆和情感被开启。随着事件发展，双越结识了洛家堡双子洛埋名和洛昭言、千年狼妖闲卿、顾寒江和明绣师徒以及居十方等江湖人士，二人的真实身份也逐渐揭开。

programme.title: Orangutan Jungle School Season 2
programme.desc: The race is on to find Tulia and Zalipa, who are missing from Palas Island. And after months of convalescence, Beni returns to forest school but faces another setback at the milk bucket. Meanwhile, the vets keep a close eye on pregnant Dilla.

programme.title: Africa's Wild Year Season 1
programme.desc: Autumn in Africa brings opportunities. Cape Fur seals, Samango monkeys, chameleons, impala, and more respond to the season. Autumn triggers changes in the lives of many animals. Rare creatures reveal themselves and predators gather to take advantage.

programme.title: Africa's Wild Year Season 1
programme.desc: Be an eyewitness to the death and resurrection that winter brings to Africa. Observe what comes with shorter days, from drought conditions to frigid winds, and marvel at the survival skills of animals and plants as they face the season's fury.

programme.title: Secrets of the Enchanted Waters Season 1
programme.desc: Trace dazzling waterways all over the world, from volcanic rivers in Russia's far east to geothermal streams in Florida. Watch as beavers transform entire landscapes with their well-engineered dams, then enjoy a winter spa day with manatees.

programme.title: Africa's Hunters Season 3
programme.desc: As the lionesses set out to recover the males who are needed to hunt buffalo, they must cross a crocodile-infested river. Follow Milo, the only cub in the mighty Mwamba pride, as he's saved from snapping jaws and cements the family's future.

programme.title: Africa's Hunters Season 3
programme.desc: If the tiny Nsefu pride is to survive, the teen Misfit and his older brother must quickly perfect their hunting skills. Trek into enemy territory as the lions face dominant rivals and a powerful hyena clan in the search for prey.

programme.title: Wild Dogs: Pack vs. Pride Season 2
programme.desc: Run into a lion-hyena showdown with Julz as he hunts for the elusive Manzi pack, who are missing four of their precious pups. Then join Henry from the Zambian Carnivore Programme on a house call to the Kakumbi den, where another pup has gone AWOL.

programme.title: Africa's Hunters Season 3
programme.desc: As the lionesses set out to recover the males who are needed to hunt buffalo, they must cross a crocodile-infested river. Follow Milo, the only cub in the mighty Mwamba pride, as he's saved from snapping jaws and cements the family's future.

programme.title: Africa's Hunters Season 3
programme.desc: If the tiny Nsefu pride is to survive, the teen Misfit and his older brother must quickly perfect their hunting skills. Trek into enemy territory as the lions face dominant rivals and a powerful hyena clan in the search for prey.

programme.title: Superbeast Season 1
programme.desc: Prowl the ocean with sharks of all kinds and see why these predatory fish reign supreme under the sea. Stalk coral labyrinths with reef sharks, lie in wait for the perfect strike with wobbegongs, and embark on epic migrations with great whites.

programme.title: Kalahari: Land of Secret Alliances Season 1
programme.desc: Thirst for rain alongside the animals of the Kalahari, as they endure a brutally dry year. Witness co-operation between elephant herds in their desperate search for water and meet a meerkat's strange babysitter, who helps the next generation survive.

programme.title: Kalahari: Land of Secret Alliances Season 1
programme.desc: Track scientists who have arrived in the Kalahari to test a hypothesis: that animal collaboration is the key to the dizzying diversity of the region's species. Observe as they monitor behavior, decipher data, and deliver fascinating conclusions.

programme.title: Pridelands: Wilderness Reborn
programme.desc: An Australian family go on an adventure to restore an old hunting ranch in South Africa. Their goal is to rebuild the overgrown habitat, create an eco-tourism ranch, and allow the natural wildlife, including predators, to move back in.

programme.title: Orangutan Jungle School Season 2
programme.desc: The fate of several graduates awaits the next round of wild releases. Meanwhile, runaway Zalipa is found, but her partner in crime, Tulia, is still missing. And Baby Clarita has a complete meltdown as the vets perform surgery on her mother.

The Last Dance
programme.desc: 在疫情肆虐生意萧条的情况下，债台高筑的婚礼策划师道生转型为葬礼经纪人，寻求新的出路。凭借创新且独特的经营策略，道生意外获得成功；在德高望重的喃呒师傅文哥的启发下，他的职业观与人生态度随之逐渐蜕变。

programme.title: P风暴
P Storm
programme.desc: 廖雨萍向廉政公署举报一个富二代在监狱中行贿惩教人员，以包庇他和其团伙在狱中的恶行。廉政公署首席调查主任陆志廉以囚犯的卧底身份入狱调查。尽管监狱危机四伏，陆志廉决定在狱友王蓝禄的帮助下，完成他的任务。

programme.title: 七月与安生
Soul Mate
programme.desc: 七月与安生自十三岁开始认识并成为莫逆之交。她们以为会永远陪伴在彼此的生命里，直到十八岁时遇见了男生苏家明，三人纠缠在隐秘的三角关系中。感情的角力令二人友情受到考验，亦改写各自往后的命运。

programme.title: 别叫我"赌神"
One More Chance
programme.desc: 嗜赌成性的吹水辉因前女友托付，照顾患有自闭症的儿子。这段突如其来的父子生活，由混乱至彼此救赎，他逐渐找回自我。当发现儿子拥有跑步天赋后，他决心告别过去，陪伴儿子追逐梦想。

programme.title: 出走的决心
Like A Rolling Stone
programme.desc: 中国式好妈妈李红半生任劳任怨，在日复一日的家务与丈夫的冷漠中感到窒息。一场高中同学会意外点燃了她被埋没的青春梦想，她决定打破沉重的家庭枷锁，向妻子与母亲的身份「辞职」。李红毅然驾车出走，独自踏上重启人生的漫漫旅程，在广阔天地间寻回那个遗失已久的自我。

programme.title: 无双
Project Gutenberg
programme.desc: 警方追缉一个以“画家”为神秘首脑的伪钞集团，集团用高超的造假技术制作出真假难辨的伪钞，并在全球进行交易获取利益。然而“画家”的身份一直成谜，警方唯有聘请擅长绘画的李问助其找出他的真实身份。

programme.title: 热烈
One and Only
programme.desc: 街舞老手丁雷力邀热衷街舞的陈烁加入自己经营的街舞团。舞团内高手如云，训练期间与陈烁碰撞出不同的火花。陈烁热烈追梦，并期待着上场的机会，却发现丁雷邀请他其实另有目的。丁雷和陈烁各自面对人生接二连三的沉重打击。他们能否逆风翻盘，回击人生难题？

programme.title: 秘密访客
Home Sweet Home
programme.desc: 一场惨烈的校车车祸，导致几乎全部学童丧生。司机拼命救回一名男孩，却令自己失去部分记忆。男孩的父亲为答救命之恩，把司机带到自家地下室里与他们共同生活。司机渐渐发现这家人的行为诡秘，众人的异常更似乎与那场车祸有关…

programme.title: 一出好戏
The Island
programme.desc: 一场突如其来的陨石撞击地球，使一群正值团队建设之旅的员工遇上意外，流落荒岛。其中一个小职员马进坚决要逃出险境，因为他刚中了六千万元的彩票，需在九十天内兑奖。他最终能成功领奖吗？

programme.title: 私家侦探
Behind the Shadows
programme.desc: 私家侦探欧阳伟业在办案途中意外发现妻子出轨，震惊之下，他放弃了另一宗失踪人口案的追查。不久，该失踪者被发现遇害，警员陈康民怀疑背后潜藏连环杀手。为阻止凶手再次犯案，欧阳伟业必须凭借侦探直觉，力挽狂澜。

programme.title: 冲天火
Sky on Fire
programme.desc: 任职于顶尖秘密医疗设施的保安主任宗天保，在一名年轻窃贼盗取一种突破性新药后，卷入了一场激烈的争斗。然而，当他揭开该药物的真正起源后，宗天保必须寻找可靠的盟友来保护这药物，确保它不落入歹徒之手，并阻止一场残酷的争夺战爆发。

programme.title: 4拍4家族

programme.title: CAHAYA CINTA AZZURA 2
programme.desc: Cahaya is a beautiful young woman who works at a fish farm owned by Adipura, a wealthy businessman in a village in Sukabumi. One day, Cahaya's father is involved in an accident and is hospitalized. Desperate to find money for his treatment, Cahaya turns to Adipura for help. Adipura agrees, but on one condition: Cahaya must marry him.

programme.title: SAYAP CINTA TERINDAH EPS 31
programme.desc: It tells the story of Dhani, the firm and responsible eldest son, as he strives to take care of his three younger siblings (David, Ariel, and Isyana) in order to fulfill their father Haris's dream of having a harmonious family. Dhani carries a heavy burden, but he faces serious challenges as his siblings resent him and each of them harbors their own complicated secrets.

programme.title: CINTA SEPENUH JIWA EPS 135
programme.desc: Lala is a young girl, the second daughter of Andi and Desi, who since childhood has carried enthusiasm and a smile with her every step. Her life is simple but full of color thanks to one thing she truly loves: cooking. For Lala, the kitchen is not just a place to prepare ingredients. It is a space for expression, a place where she pours out her emotions, wraps stories into every seasoning, and serves love through every dish. With the support of Hasbi—her boyfriend who later becomes her husban...

programme.title: CAHAYA TERINDAH EPS 62-63
programme.desc: A drama series that tells the story of Indah (Ranty Maria) and her struggle to find her biological family after discovering that she was adopted. She runs away to Jakarta from her adoptive father (Jamal), who intends to sell her, and ends up working for the Hendardi family, where she faces romantic conflicts and emotional mysteries from her past.

programme.title: TURUN RANJANG EPS 32
programme.desc: Albi (Samuel Zylgwyn) is forced to marry his sister-in-law, Naza (Rachquel Nesia), at the request of his father-in-law, Wira. This decision is made for the sake of caring for baby Zia (Faradilla Yoshi), Albi's wife, who falls into a coma after giving birth. This pressured marriage becomes difficult for both Albi and Naza, as they were previously in love with other people.

programme.title: TERIKAT JANJI EPS 32
programme.desc: A drama series that tells the story of Davina, a conglomerate's daughter who falls into poverty after being betrayed. She is forced to pretend to be in a relationship with Sena, a ketoprak street vendor. This fake relationship, meant to protect her reputation, becomes complicated when Sena is actually an undercover intelligence agent on a mission tied to his past—further intensified by conflicts involving a stepmother and past betrayals.

programme.title: CINTA BERAKHIR BAHAGIA 106-107
programme.desc: Adisty, a beautiful young woman who serves as the backbone of her family, nearly becomes a sex worker to pay off her family's debts. However, fate brings her together with Pasha, a respectable man from a wealthy family. Unbeknownst to them, they were actually switched at birth. What will happen to Adisty and Pasha's lives?

programme.title: 利剑.玫瑰
Sword Rose
programme.desc: 一心想要查找缉毒警察男友死亡真相的女警花邓妍，在一次解救人质的意外行动中大放异彩，被调到打拐办任代理主任。邓妍通过缜密的推理、精准的判断力以及奋不顾身的行动，让原本持怀疑态度的同事变为钦佩和坚定支持。面对罪犯的狡猾和凶残，邓妍与同事们共同努力，剥茧抽丝，终将拐卖妇女儿童犯罪团伙的一个个犯罪嫌疑人绳之以法。与此同时，男友被害的真相也渐渐浮出水面。Police officer Hua Deng Yan hopes to join the anti-drug team to find out the truth behind her boyfriend's death. However, she shines during an unexpected operation which earns her a promotion to the acting director of the anti-trafficking team. Hua Deng Yan becomes part of the six-member anti-trafficking team that pits wit...

programme.title: 嗨放派 3
Have Fun Season 3
programme.desc: 《嗨放派》是一档奇趣实验类真人秀综艺节目，第三季主打真实的生存实验，六位艺人嘉宾将开启十天荒岛生存挑战，比如需要自食其力体验搭建帐篷、自制淋浴间、起火烧饭、自制做饭器具等挑战，最后还要举行一场别开生面的海岛运动会，用最好玩的方式将科学实践到生活里头。 “Have Fun” returns for a third season! The very well-received China variety again sees six popular male artistes teaming up to escape the constraints and pressures of city life and having fun through exploring interesting scientific topics and real-life Science experiments, this time on a remote island looking for survival!

programme.title: 淮水竹亭
Love in Pavilion
programme.desc: 《淮水竹亭》是《狐妖小红娘》的第二部曲，讲述了在人妖势不两立的局势下，两大家族东方家和王权家的掌舵人东方淮竹和王权弘业为了重振一气盟，共同努力安定局势的故事。The second installment of the popular “Fox Spirit Matchmaker” series – “Love in Pavilion” depicts the story of Dongfang Huaizhu and Wangquan Hongye, leaders of the two major families, Dongfang and Wangquan. In a time when humans and demons are in conflict, they work together to stabilize the situation to revive the Unity Alliance. On the seventh day of the seventh month, at the Bamboo Pavilion by the Huai River, th...

programme.title: 灼灼韶华
Wild Ambition Bloom
programme.desc: 1916年，褚韶华为救哥哥而嫁给陈记药铺大少爷陈大顺，她以诚信和出色的商业得到陈父的赏识，成为药铺管理人。陈父和陈大顺意外去世后，陈二顺继承药铺并败光家财，药铺陷入绝境。褚韶华在艰辛努力下，开了华顺药铺养活一家老小。褚韶华后决意携手初恋情人夏初开启新生活，却遭陈二顺和陈母阻挠。陈家被土匪洗劫一空，褚韶华也在这次劫难中失去女儿，伤心不已的她独自出走上海。褚韶华在上海永新百货业绩突出，受经营奇才闻知秋之邀共同创业，逐步成长为胆略过人、重诺守信的女商人。This is the story of Chu, who came from a family of traditional Chinese medicine in the early years of China and her life revolving round three men - Xia Chu, Chen Da Shun, and Wen Zhi Qiu. Not succumbing to the unfair arrangements of the times and fate, Chu gradually ex...

programme.title: 他从火光中走来
Bright Eyes in the Dark
programme.desc: 林陆骁拥有过人的消防技巧和丰富的消防经验，是北浔市特勤一站站长。因缘际会下，他被选中成了一档旨在科普消防知识的真人节目的教官。在节目中林陆骁偶遇自己多年前从火场中救下的舞蹈演员南初。南初对林陆骁充满好感，但林陆骁却因深知自己职业的危险而不愿靠近。年轻而勇敢的新一代消防员如邵一九、秦十全等崭露头角，从国外带回先进装备技术的楼明冶也回到了消防队。老中青三代消防员们在火灾、地震、空中救援等灾情救援中通力合作，将北浔市的消防安全水平提升了一个台阶。南初与林陆骁也在逐渐深入了解中确定了自己的心意，面临最危险的森林火灾，林陆骁与他的队友们依然选择逆火前进。

programme.title: 大泼猴
The Legends Of Monkey King
programme.desc:
天道变数，石妖提前三百年破石而出，生存堪忧的石妖踏上了寻仙之路。他在求仙路上九死一生，幸得金丝雀舍命相救，石妖因此许下了复活金丝雀的诺言。为了实现诺言，石妖一路拜师修行，其间与天真烂漫的风铃和孤傲高冷的杨岚分别暗生情愫，还卷入了众妖与天庭的对抗之中。
A mortal man accidentally time-travels to the past and becomes the Monkey King. Unwilling to accept his fate, he embarks on a journey that brings him to face gods and demons.

programme.desc:
徐冬熙梦想成为服装设计师，一场突如其来的意外，却让她必须领养侄子成为了单亲妈妈，多亏家人及邻居协助，让她在照顾侄子之余仍得以重拾曾经放弃的梦想。姜次烈则年幼时父亲去世，其后被叔叔收养，虽曾有彷徨时期，但他头脑聪明、成绩和外貌出众，可是他做的越好，哥哥和妈妈的表情就越冷淡。为了迎合母亲的喜好，次烈无法凭自己的意愿生活，虽然不想继承家族企业却被安排进入公司工作，虽不开心但也只能等着离开这个家独立的日子…

programme.desc: 1916年，褚韶华为救哥哥而嫁给陈记药铺大少爷陈大顺，她以诚信和出色的商业得到陈父的赏识，成为药铺管理人。陈父和陈大顺意外去世后，陈二顺继承药铺并败光家财，药铺陷入绝境。褚韶华在艰辛努力下，开了华顺药铺养活一家老小。褚韶华后决意携手初恋情人夏初开启新生活，却遭陈二顺和陈母阻挠。陈家被土匪洗劫一空，褚韶华也在这次劫难中失去女儿，伤心不已的她独自出走上海。褚韶华在上海永新百货业绩突出，受经营奇才闻知秋之邀共同创业，逐步成长为胆略过人、重诺守信的女商人。This is the story of Chu, who came from a family of traditional Chinese medicine in the early years of China and her life revolving round three men - Xia Chu, Chen Da Shun, and Wen Zhi Qiu. programme.title: 这就是街舞 6
Street Dance of China 6
programme.desc: 《这！就是街舞》再次强势回归，第六季节目迎来了常驻舞蹈导师的全新组合，包括Jay Park、Vanness 吴建豪、丁程鑫，都是非常优秀的舞者以及队长。在全新一季《这！就是街舞》中，将会有哪些街舞大神为大家带来热血炸裂的舞台？内容上不断带来惊喜外，让我们共同期待街舞引燃2023！

programme.title: 勇敢无双龙秀晶
The Brave Yong Su Jeong
programme.desc: 该剧为一部浪漫复仇剧，讲述了梦想成为现代版巨商林尚玉的女子龙秀晶与将命运托付给她的吝啬鬼绝症患者吕义柱相遇后，两人共同展开复仇的故事。剧中还涉及与财阀家族相关的出生秘密等人物关系。Yong Su-Jeong is a popular but shy-in-love host who has a crush on a rich heir, Joo Woo-Jin, while hardworking Yeo Ui-Joo’s life changes when he discovers he’s also part of the same wealthy family.

Sword Rose
programme.desc: 一心想要查找缉毒警察男友死亡真相的女警花邓妍，在一次解救人质的意外行动中大放异彩，被调到打拐办任代理主任。邓妍通过缜密的推理、精准的判断力以及奋不顾身的行动，让原本持怀疑态度的同事变为钦佩和坚定支持。面对罪犯的狡猾和凶残，邓妍与同事们共同努力，剥茧抽丝，终将拐卖妇女儿童犯罪团伙的一个个犯罪嫌疑人绳之以法。与此同时，男友被害的真相也渐渐浮出水面。Police officer Hua Deng Yan hopes to join the anti-drug team to find out the truth behind her boyfriend's death. programme.title: 他从火光中走来
Bright Eyes in the Dark
programme.desc: 林陆骁拥有过人的消防技巧和丰富的消防经验，是北浔市特勤一站站长。因缘际会下，他被选中成了一档旨在科普消防知识的真人节目的教官。在节目中林陆骁偶遇自己多年前从火场中救下的舞蹈演员南初。南初对林陆骁充满好感，但林陆骁却因深知自己职业的危险而不愿靠近。年轻而勇敢的新一代消防员如邵一九、秦十全等崭露头角，从国外带回先进装备技术的楼明冶也回到了消防队。老中青三代消防员们在火灾、地震、空中救援等灾情救援中通力合作，将北浔市的消防安全水平提升了一个台阶。南初与林陆骁也在逐渐深入了解中确定了自己的心意，面临最危险的森林火灾，林陆骁与他的队友们依然选择逆火前进。

programme.title: 翘楚
Ashes to Crown
programme.desc: 将军之女楚朝为改变自己成为楚国世子萧珣夺权路上牺牲品的可悲命运，发现主动出击才是改变命运的唯一途径。在与命运一波三折的对抗中，她与谢家庶子谢燕来相识，并点亮了谢燕来原本灰暗的人生，助谢燕来挣脱命运枷锁，从禁军小卒成长为镇国大将军。楚朝与谢燕来合力成功阻止了世子的野心和计划，在本该逃离是非之地的途中，见到战火中百姓的苦难，楚朝毅然返回城内，助力小皇孙萧羽为帝，直至萧羽亲政。然而萧珣又引外敌来犯，为权欲不惜陷万民于水火。楚朝携手谢燕来与之殊死抵抗，领军浴血奋战，终于成功解除大楚内忧外患。至此，楚朝不仅改变了自己的命运，也让大楚千千万万百姓摆脱了战火离乱的颠沛命运。Reborn before her fateful marriage, General's daughter Chu Chao vows to avert her family's tragic doom. She secures the throne for the young heir, earning the title of Grand Princess. When foreign forces invade, Ch...

programme.title: 在暴雪时分
Amidst a Snowstorm of Love
programme.desc: 昔日天才级职业斯诺克选手林亦扬与当红九球选手殷果相遇在一场十年难得一遇的暴雪之夜。在殷果表弟的助攻之下，两人慢慢熟识。殷果也了解到林亦扬的往事。原来林亦扬曾经也是轰动一时的斯诺克天才，在一次比赛中因对裁判判罚有异议，争取时无意冲撞裁判而被禁赛，少年气盛的他不服判决，竟直接宣布退役，从此离开了自己引以为傲的斯诺克事业。殷果的出现，让林亦扬的人生轨迹再次转变，林亦扬不仅开始努力地追求殷果，还在殷果的带动下重拾最初的梦想，返回斯诺克赛场。最终二人共攀事业高峰，一同为职业台球事业贡献力量，并携手教练与队友，共推全民健身台球项目发展。

programme.title: 祈今朝
Sword and Fairy
programme.desc: 越今朝和越祈二人在乌岩村相伴三年，有着神奇的“共鸣”关系，却对各自的身世一无所知。二人携手闯荡江湖，希望找回过往记忆。双越二人被卷入启魂圣宗作乱和洛家堡血祭等神秘事件之中，而在对抗圣宗过程中意外让越祈被封印的回忆和情感被开启。随着事件发展，双越结识了洛家堡双子洛埋名和洛昭言、千年狼妖闲卿、顾寒江和明绣师徒以及居十方等江湖人士，二人的真实身份也逐渐揭开。

programme.title: 余生有涯
Light Beyond the Reed
programme.desc: 她是一个再普通不过的女人，有着一份薪水微薄的工作，一个沉默寡言的丈夫。她以为自己永远普通，直到有一天晚上，厄运猛然降临，她开始活在黑暗里。她怕有人说她那天晚上出席酒局，也怕有人说她那天晚上穿了裙子。她怕丈夫指责她不贞，也怕家人辱骂她败德。直到一切无法隐藏，她一贯寡言的丈夫坐在沙发上，抽完了最后一根烟，看向蜷缩在角落里哭得不成样子的她。然后他拉着她的手，报警，追凶，上诉。用余生和性命，去为她求一个公道，要一份天理，给一份爱。An ordinary woman with an ordinary life and an ordinary husband. Until one night, her husband forgot to pick her up at the wine party she was attending, leading to her being raped. But because she was afraid to be blamed for getting drunk, to be blamed for having worn a dress, to be ...

programme.title: 亦舞之城
Second Chance Romance
programme.desc: 著名芭蕾舞艺术家谭思婷盛名之下退役归国，与曾经的恋人冯睿意外重逢，经历重重波折后最终破镜重圆的故事。多年前两人因误会遗憾分手，简单真挚的校园恋爱无疾而终。久别重逢后两颗平静的心再次泛起涟漪，压抑不住对彼此的思念。而冯睿被谭思婷对芭蕾梦想的执着追求与热爱，以及对自己始终如一的情感所打动，最终冯睿放下心结勇敢追爱，有情人终成眷属，谭思婷的芭蕾事业也得以薪火相传。Ballet dancer Tan Siting retired and returned to China to teach, dedicating herself to nurturing new talent. She met a young dancer, Zheng Yufan, who was struggling, and devoted all her knowledge to help her win gold at an international competition. Tan Siting’s spirit of pursuing her dreams earned widespread acclai...

programme.desc: 她是一个再普通不过的女人，有着一份薪水微薄的工作，一个沉默寡言的丈夫。她以为自己永远普通，直到有一天晚上，厄运猛然降临，她开始活在黑暗里。她怕有人说她那天晚上出席酒局，也怕有人说她那天晚上穿了裙子。她怕丈夫指责她不贞，也怕家人辱骂她败德。直到一切无法隐藏，她一贯寡言的丈夫坐在沙发上，抽完了最后一根烟，看向蜷缩在角落里哭得不成样子的她。然后他拉着她的手，报警，追凶，上诉。用余生和性命，去为她求一个公道，要一份天理，给一份爱。An ordinary woman with an ordinary life and an ordinary husband. Until one night, her husband forgot to pick her up at the wine party she was attending, leading to her being raped. programme.title: 亦舞之城
Second Chance Romance
programme.desc: 著名芭蕾舞艺术家谭思婷盛名之下退役归国，与曾经的恋人冯睿意外重逢，经历重重波折后最终破镜重圆的故事。多年前两人因误会遗憾分手，简单真挚的校园恋爱无疾而终。久别重逢后两颗平静的心再次泛起涟漪，压抑不住对彼此的思念。而冯睿被谭思婷对芭蕾梦想的执着追求与热爱，以及对自己始终如一的情感所打动，最终冯睿放下心结勇敢追爱，有情人终成眷属，谭思婷的芭蕾事业也得以薪火相传。Ballet dancer Tan Siting retired and returned to China to teach, dedicating herself to nurturing new talent. programme.title: 在暴雪时分
Amidst a Snowstorm of Love
programme.desc: 昔日天才级职业斯诺克选手林亦扬与当红九球选手殷果相遇在一场十年难得一遇的暴雪之夜。在殷果表弟的助攻之下，两人慢慢熟识。殷果也了解到林亦扬的往事。原来林亦扬曾经也是轰动一时的斯诺克天才，在一次比赛中因对裁判判罚有异议，争取时无意冲撞裁判而被禁赛，少年气盛的他不服判决，竟直接宣布退役，从此离开了自己引以为傲的斯诺克事业。殷果的出现，让林亦扬的人生轨迹再次转变，林亦扬不仅开始努力地追求殷果，还在殷果的带动下重拾最初的梦想，返回斯诺克赛场。最终二人共攀事业高峰，一同为职业台球事业贡献力量，并携手教练与队友，共推全民健身台球项目发展。

programme.title: 祈今朝
Sword and Fairy
programme.desc: 越今朝和越祈二人在乌岩村相伴三年，有着神奇的“共鸣”关系，却对各自的身世一无所知。二人携手闯荡江湖，希望找回过往记忆。双越二人被卷入启魂圣宗作乱和洛家堡血祭等神秘事件之中，而在对抗圣宗过程中意外让越祈被封印的回忆和情感被开启。随着事件发展，双越结识了洛家堡双子洛埋名和洛昭言、千年狼妖闲卿、顾寒江和明绣师徒以及居十方等江湖人士，二人的真实身份也逐渐揭开。

programme.title: Orangutan Jungle School Season 2
programme.desc: The fate of several graduates awaits the next round of wild releases. Meanwhile, runaway Zalipa is found, but her partner in crime, Tulia, is still missing. And Baby Clarita has a complete meltdown as the vets perform surgery on her mother.

programme.title: Africa's Hunters Season 3
programme.desc: As the lionesses set out to recover the males who are needed to hunt buffalo, they must cross a crocodile-infested river. Follow Milo, the only cub in the mighty Mwamba pride, as he's saved from snapping jaws and cements the family's future.

programme.title: Africa's Hunters Season 3
programme.desc: If the tiny Nsefu pride is to survive, the teen Misfit and his older brother must quickly perfect their hunting skills. Trek into enemy territory as the lions face dominant rivals and a powerful hyena clan in the search for prey.

programme.title: Secrets of the Enchanted Waters Season 1
programme.desc: Journey through mystical lakes, where life adapts, survives, and transforms. Witness the power of ancient beasts like the snapping turtle, watch a dragonfly metamorphosis, and walk tall with flamingoes as they brave burning, corrosive waters.

programme.title: Kalahari: Land of Secret Alliances Season 1
programme.desc: Thirst for rain alongside the animals of the Kalahari, as they endure a brutally dry year. Witness co-operation between elephant herds in their desperate search for water and meet a meerkat's strange babysitter, who helps the next generation survive.

programme.title: Kalahari: Land of Secret Alliances Season 1
programme.desc: Track scientists who have arrived in the Kalahari to test a hypothesis: that animal collaboration is the key to the dizzying diversity of the region's species. Observe as they monitor behavior, decipher data, and deliver fascinating conclusions.

programme.title: Wild Dogs: Pack vs. Pride Season 2

Perfect Match (2019)

programme.title: 非來不可 第2季
Fantastic Journey Season 2
programme.desc: 孟非、劉震雲決心效仿中國最早的自由行「西遊」，攜何廣智、李雅娟升級為「非震式旅行社」；邀請尹正、哈妮克孜、武藝、張雨綺、楊迪、楊超越等飛行嘉賓，先後到達喀什，塔什庫爾干，獨庫公路，烏茲別克斯坦等地，串聯起雪山草原、戈壁大漠、城市綠洲，開啟一場前所未有的奇遇之旅。

programme.title: 緣來不晚 第4季
Love Never Comes Late Season 4
programme.desc: 專為資深單身人士定制的相親交友節目，每集有4位男嘉賓和3位女嘉賓，依序進行一對一交流。未上場嘉賓則分別在男女嘉賓室觀察場上溝通情況，加深對有意對象的瞭解。節目主張為愛回歸，愛情不分年齡，緣來從來不晚。

programme.title: 姐姐當家
Her Prime
programme.desc: 聚焦女性主題生活觀察真人秀，邀請了謝娜、董璇、王琳與萬千惠為姐姐團成員，透過她們在「當家」過程中所面對的現實困境，探討與女性相關的選擇、情感、家庭等議題，激發出每一位女性的幽默、堅持和勇氣。

programme.title: 美好生活荔枝幫
A Wonderful Life Starts with Health
programme.desc: 兼顧情緒價值輸出，為女性量身打造兼具時尚審美與人文關懷的變裝微綜藝，全方位多角度地向社會傳遞積極的生活態度；種草生活好物、推薦文旅線路、科普健康知識。

programme.title: 音你而來 第3季
The Melody of You Season 3
programme.desc: 「音樂+旅行+社交」的唱演真人秀，由王赫野、王琳凱、張碧晨三位老友攜手劉雨昕、周震南、姚曉棠、容祖兒等多位新朋友，跟隨「音你小隊」開啟全新的集體旅居生活；音樂人將在絕美的自然風光中尋找創作靈感，通過音樂與當地人產生連接與互動，帶來一場充滿人情味的治療音樂之旅。

programme.title: 遊遍江蘇 第4季
Travel through Jiangsu Season 4
programme.desc: 遊遍江蘇全省的名勝古蹟和大街小巷，尋訪文史學家、學者，走訪民間藝人工匠等，探尋風景背後的動人故事，深度觸摸江蘇的文化脈搏，帶領大家發現江蘇的獨特魅力。

programme.title: 與君渡長歡 (短劇)
Eternal Joy With You (Mini drama)
programme.desc: 藥商之女許婉寧前世遭丈夫背叛、親生骨肉被害，含恨重生；為了守護孩子並復仇，她與調查禁藥的金鱗衛大督主裴珩結盟，兩人從互有成見的試探，到相知相許的聯手，不僅粉碎了危害朝政的驚天陰謀，更在夢境與現實的交錯中，讓女主重獲自救的勇氣，開啟了全新人生。

programme.title: 黑月光法則 (短劇)
Princess Revenge (Mini drama)
programme.desc: 名門千金東方曦為愛隱姓埋名打工供養男友，慘遭背叛後覺醒，竟發現自己身處小說世界，成了注定悲劇的惡毒女配；為了改寫命運，她與系統達成賭約，不僅當眾揭穿了渣男的真面目，更發現暗中守護自己的大哥竟是系統化身。這是一場關於覺醒、反殺與破局的奇幻愛戀，挑戰傳統的黑月光法則。

programme.title: 國醫少年志 第2季
Traditional Chinese Medicine Youth Chronicles Season 2
programme.desc: 由徐璐、夏之光、高瀚宇、李雅娟組成國醫少年團，通過年輕化視角拆解中醫奧秘，讓中醫藥文化穿越千年時光，讓更多的年輕人讀懂中醫、愛上中醫，看見傳統醫學在現代生活中的蓬勃生命力。

programme.title: 半熟戀人 第4季
Love Actually Season 4 (Repackaged)
programme.desc: 30+的素人嘉賓們帶著成熟與期待，在摩登都市上海入住郊區小屋，從陌生到熟悉，從心動到堅定，共同開啟一段30天的尋愛之旅；除了元老嘉賓謝楠、張純燁、唐藝昕之外，更邀請了徐藝洋和顏安等組成「半熟觀察員」，一同見證高甜瞬間。

programme.title: 音你而來 第3季
The Melody of You Season 3
programme.desc: 「音樂+旅行+社交」的唱演真人秀，由王赫野、王琳凱、張碧晨三位老友攜手劉雨昕、周震南、姚曉棠、容祖兒等多位新朋友，跟隨「音你小隊」開啟全新的集體旅居生活；音樂人將在絕美的自然風光中尋找創作靈感，通過音樂與當地人產生連接與互動，帶來一場充滿人情味的治療音樂之旅。

programme.title: 緣來不晚 第4季
Love Never Comes Late Season 4
programme.desc: 專為資深單身人士定制的相親交友節目，每集有4位男嘉賓和3位女嘉賓，依序進行一對一交流。未上場嘉賓則分別在男女嘉賓室觀察場上溝通情況，加深對有意對象的瞭解。節目主張為愛回歸，愛情不分年齡，緣來從來不晚。

programme.title: 與君渡長歡 (短劇)
Eternal Joy With You (Mini drama)
programme.desc: 藥商之女許婉寧前世遭丈夫背叛、親生骨肉被害，含恨重生；為了守護孩子並復仇，她與調查禁藥的金鱗衛大督主裴珩結盟，兩人從互有成見的試探，到相知相許的聯手，不僅粉碎了危害朝政的驚天陰謀，更在夢境與現實的交錯中，讓女主重獲自救的勇氣，開啟了全新人生。

programme.title: 黑月光法則 (短劇)
Princess Revenge (Mini drama)
programme.desc: 名門千金東方曦為愛隱姓埋名打工供養男友，慘遭背叛後覺醒，竟發現自己身處小說世界，成了注定悲劇的惡毒女配；為了改寫命運，她與系統達成賭約，不僅當眾揭穿了渣男的真面目，更發現暗中守護自己的大哥竟是系統化身。這是一場關於覺醒、反殺與破局的奇幻愛戀，挑戰傳統的黑月光法則。

programme.title: 超燃青春的合唱
Voices of Youth
programme.desc: 集結25位跨領域青春藝人，組建國內首個全明星流行表演合唱團「燃青團」；跳出傳統音樂真人秀的固化框架，不爭C位、不設淘汰，更關注合唱聲部，以團魂養成、情緒共振為核心，帶來全新觀看體驗；全景式記錄一群年輕人從陌生疏離到默契共生，從個體閃耀到集體綻放的熱血蛻變歷程。

programme.title: 非誠勿擾(2021) (S12)
Perfect Match (2021)
programme.desc: 《非誠勿擾》回歸經典規則。男嘉賓登場後，將通過「愛之請回答」「愛之再判斷」「愛之終決選」三個環節與24位女嘉賓互相了解，還有根據大數據匹配的「智推女生」參與最終決選。陳銘、黃瀾加盟「非誠合夥人」，以全新視角解讀愛情。

programme.title: 遊遍江蘇 第4季
Travel through Jiangsu Season 4
programme.desc: 遊遍江蘇全省的名勝古蹟和大街小巷，尋訪文史學家、學者，走訪民間藝人工匠等，探尋風景背後的動人故事，深度觸摸江蘇的文化脈搏，帶領大家發現江蘇的獨特魅力。
