Rosi, completely failing to recognize Vino behind the costume, ends up venting to him about how her ex cheated on her. Is there a chance for their old flame to be rekindled?

programme.title: Bidadari Surgamu
programme.desc: It tells the story of a girl named Sakinah who lives a life full of pressure due to slander and is forced to marry a person who does not love her. Not only that, Sakinah was even prevented from knowing who her biological mother had the heart to throw her away. How does Sakinah's life story continue?

programme.title: Naik Ranjang
programme.desc: After being separated for 20 years, Tyas sets out to find her father, Mahdi, to act as her best man at her wedding to Gino. Upon meeting Mahdi, Tyas's fiancé, Gino, is taken aback to discover Hani, Tyas's younger sister, who has a child from their past relationship.

programme.title: Udah Paling Bener Nabrak Hati Ratu Jalanan
programme.desc: Tasya (Soraya Rasyid) is a beautiful girl with a wild passion for motorcycle racing. One day, Tasya and her crew hit the streets for an illegal street race, speeding recklessly without a care for anyone else's safety. Their dangerous stunt nearly causes one of Rendy's (Bara Valentino) young students to get run over. As an elementary school teacher, Rendy is furious and nearly gets into a physical brawl with one of Tasya's friends. Seeing Rendy's explosive reaction—which the principal deems un...

programme.title: Naik Ranjang
programme.desc: After being separated for 20 years, Tyas sets out to find her father, Mahdi, to act as her best man at her wedding to Gino. Upon meeting Mahdi, Tyas's fiancé, Gino, is taken aback to discover Hani, Tyas's younger sister, who has a child from their past relationship.

programme.title: Cosplay Deket Kamu Cintanya No Play Play
programme.desc: To make ends meet and pay off her brother's mounting debts, Rana (Aylena Fusil) works daily as a roadside horror cosplayer. One day, she comes across Erza's (El Ryan Carlen) young nephew and decides to bring him home since Erza hasn't shown up to pick him up yet. However, when Erza finally arrives, he completely misunderstands the situation and accuses Rana of trying to kidnap the boy. How will this misunderstanding unfold?

programme.title: Bukan Cuma Khodam, Love Tester Kita Juga Cocok
programme.desc: Rani (Aylena Fusil) goes to the market to buy coconut milk from Aris (Masaji Wijayanto). Due to a classic misunderstanding, Aris thinks Rani hasn't paid yet and goes chasing after her to demand the money. Meanwhile, Rani's grandmother, desperate to see her granddaughter find the perfect match, consults a psychic to find out what kind of man is destined for Rani. What will happen next?

programme.title: Bidadari Surgamu
programme.desc: It tells the story of a girl named Sakinah who lives a life full of pressure due to slander and is forced to marry a person who does not love her. Not only that, Sakinah was even prevented from knowing who her biological mother had the heart to throw her away. How does Sakinah's life story continue?

programme.title: Pesona 34-ku Bakalan Badabest Meluluhkan Hatimu
programme.desc: One day, Surya (Bastian Steel) nearly crashes his car into a motorcycle ridden by Citra (Sitha Marino) and her friend. A furious Citra gets into a heated argument with Surya, who was driving recklessly and speeding in a rush. How will their story unfold from here?

programme.title: Cinta Setelah Cinta S2
programme.desc: Love After Love tells the story of the life of a family that looks perfect but turns out to have a heartbreaking secret. Feeling lucky to have a husband like Niko, a successful businessman and a daughter Audrey, Starla now has to swallow the bitterness of Niko's affair with their schoolmate, Ayu

programme.title: Aura 34 Babe Angels Bikin Hati Semrawut
programme.desc: Mayang (Emilia Samma) takes the initiative to hire Juleha (Larasati Nugroho) as a personal bodyguard for Kevin (Mahdy Reza) after he gets jumped by a group of men. However, Kevin rejects the idea out of hand. He is convinced that having Juleha as his bodyguard will only make his life miserable—plus, in his eyes, a woman being a bodyguard is just downright impossible. How will this unlikely duo get along?

programme.title: 前任4: 英年早婚
The Ex-Files 4: Marriage Plan
programme.desc: 孟云和余飞这对难兄难弟已届适婚年龄，二人在爱情路上都遭遇挑战。孟云经历分手后被家人催婚，而余飞和女友为应对婚后挑战，创立了「结婚冷静期」以应付可能出现的问题.

programme.title: 焚城
Cesium Fallout
programme.desc: 因非法偷运废料引发的一场大火，香港陷入辐射泄漏危机。为了应对这场毁灭性的灾难，专家范伟立加入由署理行政长官领导的紧急应变小组。一支消防队伍临危受命，深入辐射区，拼尽全力阻止辐射扩散。在面对前所未见的浩劫时，他们能否拯救这座城市？

programme.title: 热血合唱团
Find Your Voice
programme.desc: 「热血合唱团试验计划」打算特训由三流学校学生组成的古典音乐合唱团去参加「校际合唱团比赛」。外界对这次计划一致不看好，但美国著名华裔指挥家严梓朗，消声匿迹一年后竟答应来港担任合唱团指挥。「热血合唱团」与严指挥最终能否排除万难，完成这个不可能的任务？

programme.title: 谋杀似水年华
Kill Time
programme.desc: 小麦为找逝去父亲喜爱的一首歌曲，意外遇到一家网店「魔女区」。在此奇怪的网店，客人只可限购一次，小麦却禁不住再买一条紫色的围巾。这条围巾不但令她回忆起逝去的父亲以及初恋，更可能与一宗离奇谋杀案有着千丝万缕的关联。

programme.title: 久别重逢
Last Song For You
programme.desc: 那年盛夏，少女夏文萱和少年苏升华因一张唱片相遇相恋，当时他们最想知道这清涩的爱情能走多远。转眼数十年，音乐人苏升华在医院意外重逢初恋夏文萱，两人都身处人生低谷。夏文萱病重，看穿苏升华的内心挣扎，决定送他一段最后的旅程，希望能重燃他对生命的热情与希望。

programme.title: 射鵰英雄传：侠之大者
Legends of the Condor Heroes: The Gallants
programme.desc: 在成吉思汗及其继承者的统领下，蒙古铁骑横扫四方，先灭金朝，后将南宋视为下一目标。值此武林各派内部纷争四起之际，郭靖与黄蓉携手团结中原武林英杰，共同守卫襄阳，展现了为国奋战的无畏勇气与坚定忠诚。

programme.title: 白昼如焚
As It Burns
programme.desc: 探员魏允调查言贞在爆炸中死亡的案件，看似平凡的意外，魏允却认为疑点重重。直至他看见言贞儿时好友卢子峰的女友林音长得跟言贞十分相像，魏允随即发现连串扑朔迷离的关系，并合过去及现在的案情细节后，真相更是出人意表。

programme.title: 搜救
Come Back Home
programme.desc: 寒冬季节，阿德一家自驾游到长白山旅行，途中却因走失其八岁儿子而乐极生悲。阿德向当地派出所求助，可惜孩子仍未找到。即使黄金救援时间已过去，阿德和救援队伍仍坚持继续搜救任务。最后又能否顺利拯救儿子？

programme.title: 长安的荔枝
The Lychee Road
programme.desc: 一「荔」千金，盛唐爆笑开跑！小吏李善德奉命运送岭南贡果，须在荔枝变坏前的三日内，将鲜果跨越千里送达长安，只为满足贵妃一尝其鲜。沿途关卡重重、阻碍不断，在权力与荒诞交织下，这场「不可能任务」既惊险又讽刺，最终迎来一段笑泪交织的结局。

programme.title: 饭戏攻心
Table for Six
programme.desc: 本喜剧的三兄弟同住在已故父母所留给他们的屋檐下。大哥坚持每晚都要一家人一起吃饭，而当他们开始邀请各自的女朋友同住时，关系也变得非常紧张，从而引发出爱情与友情的矛盾和妒忌，及各种错综复杂的感情问题。六位主角将一同饭戏攻心！

programme.title: 流浪地球2
The Wandering Earth II
programme.desc: 此前传描述太阳即将毁灭，人类在地球表面建造出巨大的推进器，寻找新的家园。然而宇宙之路危机四伏，为了拯救地球，流浪地球时代的年轻人再次挺身而出，展开争分夺秒的生死之战。

programme.title: CAHAYA CINTA AZZURA 3
programme.desc: Cahaya is a beautiful young woman who works at a fish farm owned by Adipura, a wealthy businessman in a village in Sukabumi. One day, Cahaya's father is involved in an accident and is hospitalized. Desperate to find money for his treatment, Cahaya turns to Adipura for help. Adipura agrees, but on one condition: Cahaya must marry him.

programme.title: SAYAP CINTA TERINDAH EPS 32
programme.desc: It tells the story of Dhani, the firm and responsible eldest son, as he strives to take care of his three younger siblings (David, Ariel, and Isyana) in order to fulfill their father Haris's dream of having a harmonious family. Dhani carries a heavy burden, but he faces serious challenges as his siblings resent him and each of them harbors their own complicated secrets.

programme.title: CINTA SEPENUH JIWA EPS 136
programme.desc: Lala is a young girl, the second daughter of Andi and Desi, who since childhood has carried enthusiasm and a smile with her every step. Her life is simple but full of color thanks to one thing she truly loves: cooking. For Lala, the kitchen is not just a place to prepare ingredients. It is a space for expression, a place where she pours out her emotions, wraps stories into every seasoning, and serves love through every dish. With the support of Hasbi—her boyfriend who later becomes her husban...

programme.title: CAHAYA TERINDAH EPS 64
programme.desc: A drama series that tells the story of Indah (Ranty Maria) and her struggle to find her biological family after discovering that she was adopted. She runs away to Jakarta from her adoptive father (Jamal), who intends to sell her, and ends up working for the Hendardi family, where she faces romantic conflicts and emotional mysteries from her past.

programme.title: TURUN RANJANG EPS 33
programme.desc: Albi (Samuel Zylgwyn) is forced to marry his sister-in-law, Naza (Rachquel Nesia), at the request of his father-in-law, Wira. This decision is made for the sake of caring for baby Zia (Faradilla Yoshi), Albi's wife, who falls into a coma after giving birth. This pressured marriage becomes difficult for both Albi and Naza, as they were previously in love with other people.

programme.title: TERIKAT JANJI EPS 33
programme.desc: A drama series that tells the story of Davina, a conglomerate's daughter who falls into poverty after being betrayed. She is forced to pretend to be in a relationship with Sena, a ketoprak street vendor. This fake relationship, meant to protect her reputation, becomes complicated when Sena is actually an undercover intelligence agent on a mission tied to his past—further intensified by conflicts involving a stepmother and past betrayals.

programme.title: CINTA BERAKHIR BAHAGIA 108-109
programme.desc: Adisty, a beautiful young woman who serves as the backbone of her family, nearly becomes a sex worker to pay off her family's debts. She runs away to Jakarta from her adoptive father (Jamal), who intends to sell her, and ends up working for the Hendardi family, where she faces romantic conflicts and emotional mysteries from her past.

programme.title: TERIKAT JANJI EPS 34
programme.desc: A drama series that tells the story of Davina, a conglomerate's daughter who falls into poverty after being betrayed. She is forced to pretend to be in a relationship with Sena, a ketoprak street vendor. This fake relationship, meant to protect her reputation, becomes complicated when Sena is actually an undercover intelligence agent on a mission tied to his past—further intensified by conflicts involving a stepmother and past betrayals.

programme.title: TURUN RANJANG EPS 34
programme.desc: Albi (Samuel Zylgwyn) is forced to marry his sister-in-law, Naza (Rachquel Nesia), at the request of his father-in-law, Wira. This decision is made for the sake of caring for baby Zia (Faradilla Yoshi), Albi's wife, who falls into a coma after giving birth. This pressured marriage becomes difficult for both Albi and Naza, as they were previously in love with other people.

programme.title: CINTA BERAKHIR BAHAGIA 110
programme.desc: Adisty, a beautiful young woman who serves as the backbone of her family, nearly becomes a sex worker to pay off her family's debts. However, fate brings her together with Pasha, a respectable man from a wealthy family. Unbeknownst to them, they were actually switched at birth. What will happen to Adisty and Pasha's lives?

programme.title: 利剑.玫瑰
Sword Rose
programme.desc: 一心想要查找缉毒警察男友死亡真相的女警花邓妍，在一次解救人质的意外行动中大放异彩，被调到打拐办任代理主任。邓妍通过缜密的推理、精准的判断力以及奋不顾身的行动，让原本持怀疑态度的同事变为钦佩和坚定支持。面对罪犯的狡猾和凶残，邓妍与同事们共同努力，剥茧抽丝，终将拐卖妇女儿童犯罪团伙的一个个犯罪嫌疑人绳之以法。与此同时，男友被害的真相也渐渐浮出水面。Police officer Hua Deng Yan hopes to join the anti-drug team to find out the truth behind her boyfriend's death. However, she shines during an unexpected operation which earns her a promotion to the acting director of the anti-trafficking team. Hua Deng Yan becomes part of the six-member anti-trafficking team that pits wit...

programme.title: 这就是街舞 6
Street Dance of China 6
programme.desc: 《这！就是街舞》再次强势回归，第六季节目迎来了常驻舞蹈导师的全新组合，包括Jay Park、Vanness 吴建豪、丁程鑫，都是非常优秀的舞者以及队长。在全新一季《这！就是街舞》中，将会有哪些街舞大神为大家带来热血炸裂的舞台？内容上不断带来惊喜外，让我们共同期待街舞引燃2023！

programme.title: 淮水竹亭
Love in Pavilion
programme.desc: 《淮水竹亭》是《狐妖小红娘》的第二部曲，讲述了在人妖势不两立的局势下，两大家族东方家和王权家的掌舵人东方淮竹和王权弘业为了重振一气盟，共同努力安定局势的故事。The second installment of the popular “Fox Spirit Matchmaker” series – “Love in Pavilion” depicts the story of Dongfang Huaizhu and Wangquan Hongye, leaders of the two major families, Dongfang and Wangquan. In a time when humans and demons are in conflict, they work together to stabilize the situation to revive the Unity Alliance. On the seventh day of the seventh month, at the Bamboo Pavilion by the Huai River, th...

programme.title: 灼灼韶华
Wild Ambition Bloom
programme.desc: 1916年，褚韶华为救哥哥而嫁给陈记药铺大少爷陈大顺，她以诚信和出色的商业得到陈父的赏识，成为药铺管理人。陈父和陈大顺意外去世后，陈二顺继承药铺并败光家财，药铺陷入绝境。褚韶华在艰辛努力下，开了华顺药铺养活一家老小。褚韶华后决意携手初恋情人夏初开启新生活，却遭陈二顺和陈母阻挠。陈家被土匪洗劫一空，褚韶华也在这次劫难中失去女儿，伤心不已的她独自出走上海。褚韶华在上海永新百货业绩突出，受经营奇才闻知秋之邀共同创业，逐步成长为胆略过人、重诺守信的女商人。This is the story of Chu, who came from a family of traditional Chinese medicine in the early years of China and her life revolving round three men - Xia Chu, Chen Da Shun, and Wen Zhi Qiu. Not succumbing to the unfair arrangements of the times and fate, Chu gradually ex...

programme.title: 他从火光中走来
Bright Eyes in the Dark
programme.desc: 林陆骁拥有过人的消防技巧和丰富的消防经验，是北浔市特勤一站站长。因缘际会下，他被选中成了一档旨在科普消防知识的真人节目的教官。在节目中林陆骁偶遇自己多年前从火场中救下的舞蹈演员南初。南初对林陆骁充满好感，但林陆骁却因深知自己职业的危险而不愿靠近。年轻而勇敢的新一代消防员如邵一九、秦十全等崭露头角，从国外带回先进装备技术的楼明冶也回到了消防队。老中青三代消防员们在火灾、地震、空中救援等灾情救援中通力合作，将北浔市的消防安全水平提升了一个台阶。南初与林陆骁也在逐渐深入了解中确定了自己的心意，面临最危险的森林火灾，林陆骁与他的队友们依然选择逆火前进。

programme.title: 大泼猴
The Legends Of Monkey King
programme.desc:
天道变数，石妖提前三百年破石而出，生存堪忧的石妖踏上了寻仙之路。他在求仙路上九死一生，幸得金丝雀舍命相救，石妖因此许下了复活金丝雀的诺言。为了实现诺言，石妖一路拜师修行，其间与天真烂漫的风铃和孤傲高冷的杨岚分别暗生情愫，还卷入了众妖与天庭的对抗之中。
A mortal man accidentally time-travels to the past and becomes the Monkey King. Unwilling to accept his fate, he embarks on a journey that brings him to face gods and demons.

programme.desc:
《心动的信号 6》延续以往的都市男女恋爱社交推理真人秀节目的模式，节目以中素人单身男女日常相处的生活细节和情感走向为主体，每期心动侦探团来反观和解读位素人之间的情感交流和心动信号，并进行心动连线。
Reality dating show “Heart Signal” returns with a 6th season this year. The series sees single men and women live together for a period of time to find a possible love match with someone under the same roof. programme.title: 勇敢无双龙秀晶
The Brave Yong Su Jeong
programme.desc: 该剧为一部浪漫复仇剧，讲述了梦想成为现代版巨商林尚玉的女子龙秀晶与将命运托付给她的吝啬鬼绝症患者吕义柱相遇后，两人共同展开复仇的故事。剧中还涉及与财阀家族相关的出生秘密等人物关系。Yong Su-Jeong is a popular but shy-in-love host who has a crush on a rich heir, Joo Woo-Jin, while hardworking Yeo Ui-Joo’s life changes when he discovers he’s also part of the same wealthy family.

programme.desc: 1916年，褚韶华为救哥哥而嫁给陈记药铺大少爷陈大顺，她以诚信和出色的商业得到陈父的赏识，成为药铺管理人。陈父和陈大顺意外去世后，陈二顺继承药铺并败光家财，药铺陷入绝境。褚韶华在艰辛努力下，开了华顺药铺养活一家老小。褚韶华后决意携手初恋情人夏初开启新生活，却遭陈二顺和陈母阻挠。陈家被土匪洗劫一空，褚韶华也在这次劫难中失去女儿，伤心不已的她独自出走上海。褚韶华在上海永新百货业绩突出，受经营奇才闻知秋之邀共同创业，逐步成长为胆略过人、重诺守信的女商人。This is the story of Chu, who came from a family of traditional Chinese medicine in the early years of China and her life revolving round three men - Xia Chu, Chen Da Shun, and Wen Zhi Qiu. programme.title: 他从火光中走来
Bright Eyes in the Dark
programme.desc: 林陆骁拥有过人的消防技巧和丰富的消防经验，是北浔市特勤一站站长。因缘际会下，他被选中成了一档旨在科普消防知识的真人节目的教官。在节目中林陆骁偶遇自己多年前从火场中救下的舞蹈演员南初。南初对林陆骁充满好感，但林陆骁却因深知自己职业的危险而不愿靠近。年轻而勇敢的新一代消防员如邵一九、秦十全等崭露头角，从国外带回先进装备技术的楼明冶也回到了消防队。老中青三代消防员们在火灾、地震、空中救援等灾情救援中通力合作，将北浔市的消防安全水平提升了一个台阶。南初与林陆骁也在逐渐深入了解中确定了自己的心意，面临最危险的森林火灾，林陆骁与他的队友们依然选择逆火前进。

programme.title: 祈今朝
Sword and Fairy
programme.desc: 越今朝和越祈二人在乌岩村相伴三年，有着神奇的“共鸣”关系，却对各自的身世一无所知。二人携手闯荡江湖，希望找回过往记忆。双越二人被卷入启魂圣宗作乱和洛家堡血祭等神秘事件之中，而在对抗圣宗过程中意外让越祈被封印的回忆和情感被开启。随着事件发展，双越结识了洛家堡双子洛埋名和洛昭言、千年狼妖闲卿、顾寒江和明绣师徒以及居十方等江湖人士，二人的真实身份也逐渐揭开。

programme.title: 余生有涯
Light Beyond the Reed
programme.desc: 她是一个再普通不过的女人，有着一份薪水微薄的工作，一个沉默寡言的丈夫。她以为自己永远普通，直到有一天晚上，厄运猛然降临，她开始活在黑暗里。她怕有人说她那天晚上出席酒局，也怕有人说她那天晚上穿了裙子。她怕丈夫指责她不贞，也怕家人辱骂她败德。直到一切无法隐藏，她一贯寡言的丈夫坐在沙发上，抽完了最后一根烟，看向蜷缩在角落里哭得不成样子的她。然后他拉着她的手，报警，追凶，上诉。用余生和性命，去为她求一个公道，要一份天理，给一份爱。An ordinary woman with an ordinary life and an ordinary husband. Until one night, her husband forgot to pick her up at the wine party she was attending, leading to her being raped. programme.title: 亦舞之城
Second Chance Romance
programme.desc: 著名芭蕾舞艺术家谭思婷盛名之下退役归国，与曾经的恋人冯睿意外重逢，经历重重波折后最终破镜重圆的故事。多年前两人因误会遗憾分手，简单真挚的校园恋爱无疾而终。久别重逢后两颗平静的心再次泛起涟漪，压抑不住对彼此的思念。而冯睿被谭思婷对芭蕾梦想的执着追求与热爱，以及对自己始终如一的情感所打动，最终冯睿放下心结勇敢追爱，有情人终成眷属，谭思婷的芭蕾事业也得以薪火相传。Ballet dancer Tan Siting retired and returned to China to teach, dedicating herself to nurturing new talent. programme.title: 在暴雪时分
Amidst a Snowstorm of Love
programme.desc: 昔日天才级职业斯诺克选手林亦扬与当红九球选手殷果相遇在一场十年难得一遇的暴雪之夜。在殷果表弟的助攻之下，两人慢慢熟识。殷果也了解到林亦扬的往事。原来林亦扬曾经也是轰动一时的斯诺克天才，在一次比赛中因对裁判判罚有异议，争取时无意冲撞裁判而被禁赛，少年气盛的他不服判决，竟直接宣布退役，从此离开了自己引以为傲的斯诺克事业。殷果的出现，让林亦扬的人生轨迹再次转变，林亦扬不仅开始努力地追求殷果，还在殷果的带动下重拾最初的梦想，返回斯诺克赛场。最终二人共攀事业高峰，一同为职业台球事业贡献力量，并携手教练与队友，共推全民健身台球项目发展。

programme.desc: 越今朝和越祈二人在乌岩村相伴三年，有着神奇的“共鸣”关系，却对各自的身世一无所知。二人携手闯荡江湖，希望找回过往记忆。双越二人被卷入启魂圣宗作乱和洛家堡血祭等神秘事件之中，而在对抗圣宗过程中意外让越祈被封印的回忆和情感被开启。随着事件发展，双越结识了洛家堡双子洛埋名和洛昭言、千年狼妖闲卿、顾寒江和明绣师徒以及居十方等江湖人士，二人的真实身份也逐渐揭开。

programme.title: 年少有为
No Pain No Gain
programme.desc: 打工人裴谦惨遭辞退后，意外获得神秘大佬的邀请，需创办一家必须以亏损为目标的公司。于是他故意集齐各种虾兵蟹将、给员工加薪发福利，也投资了各种奇葩项目。不料竟一次次意外反转，成为了业界的商业奇才、员工心中的良心老板。有苦难言的裴谦不得不带领公司继续逆风翻盘，终成当地第一集团。Salaryman Qian is laid off but unexpectedly receives an offer from a mysterious tycoon to found a company that must operate at a loss. programme.title: 亦舞之城
Second Chance Romance
programme.desc: 著名芭蕾舞艺术家谭思婷盛名之下退役归国，与曾经的恋人冯睿意外重逢，经历重重波折后最终破镜重圆的故事。多年前两人因误会遗憾分手，简单真挚的校园恋爱无疾而终。久别重逢后两颗平静的心再次泛起涟漪，压抑不住对彼此的思念。而冯睿被谭思婷对芭蕾梦想的执着追求与热爱，以及对自己始终如一的情感所打动，最终冯睿放下心结勇敢追爱，有情人终成眷属，谭思婷的芭蕾事业也得以薪火相传。Ballet dancer Tan Siting retired and returned to China to teach, dedicating herself to nurturing new talent. programme.title: Orangutan Jungle School Season 2
programme.desc: Trouble brews when the team makes the final attempt to reunite reluctant mother Dilla with her new baby Delilah. And Alba, the world's only known albino orangutan, amazes her friends with her unique approach to termite foraging.

programme.title: Kalahari: Land of Secret Alliances Season 1
programme.desc: Thirst for rain alongside the animals of the Kalahari, as they endure a brutally dry year. Witness co-operation between elephant herds in their desperate search for water and meet a meerkat's strange babysitter, who helps the next generation survive.

programme.title: Kalahari: Land of Secret Alliances Season 1
programme.desc: Track scientists who have arrived in the Kalahari to test a hypothesis: that animal collaboration is the key to the dizzying diversity of the region's species. Observe as they monitor behavior, decipher data, and deliver fascinating conclusions.

programme.title: Secrets of the Enchanted Waters Season 1
programme.desc: Unmask the eerie beauty of swamplands, which have inspired centuries of folklore and serve as a vital link between life and death. Swim with hungry crocodiles, see deer gamble with their lives for food, and watch carnivorous plants snap up prey.

programme.title: America's Wild Seasons Season 1
programme.desc: It's spring: the season of courtship and new life. Witness nature awaken from its slumber in many forms, from the blossoms that explode in the rain-soaked desert of Arizona to the fuzzy wood ducklings that leap from their nests.

programme.title: America's Wild Seasons Season 1
programme.desc: Summer brings long, warm days for wildlife to thrive. Watch animals learn new skills, compete for mates, and escape predators as they try to make the most of the short season.

programme.title: Wild Dogs: Pack vs. Pride Season 2
programme.desc: Encounter an elephant as Julz and Henry from the ZCP track the Kakumbi pups, who face off with a stubborn, razor-tusked warthog. Follow Thandie Mweetwa, ZCP's lion specialist, who counts the prides that are pushing the Manzi out of their territory.

programme.title: Cub Camp Season 1
programme.desc: Get to know Winston, a tiny abandoned cub who imprints on Judy as she nurses him 24-7. Feel the heartbreak as she severs their emotional attachment and teaches this sweet little fellow how to be a grown-up, independent bear in the non-human world.

programme.title: Cub Camp Season 1
programme.desc: Welcome sisters Xiba, Xyla, and Xola, a trio of starving orphans who turn Winston's world upside down before gentle Xola teaches him a lesson about friendship. Then monitor new cubs Yasmine and Yara, who get reacquainted after a stressful separation.

programme.title: Becoming Elephant: the Orphans of Reteti Season 1
programme.desc: Balance the pain of goodbyes with hope for the future as a generation of rescued elephants are finally released. Welcome new additions to the Reteti family, including a baby elephant rescued from a watering hole and a traumatized zebra named Kisima.

programme.title: 非誠勿擾(2019) (S10)
Perfect Match (2019)
programme.desc: 《非誠勿擾》全新改版，24位女嘉賓分為心動區和觀察區，男嘉賓暫不亮相，在「第二現場」與女嘉賓隔空對話。男女嘉賓通過雙向選擇，決定兩人能否成功牽手。

programme.title: 極限挑戰 第十季
Go Fighting! Season 10 (Repackaged)
programme.desc: 「極挑團」原班人馬將與新成員一起解鎖更多挑戰，他們將與廣大觀眾一起跨越大江南北，體驗國民生活百態，用真心探訪這片古老土地上正在發生的溫情故事，以更豐富的視角觸摸這卷山河下每一位個體的對美好生活的深切期望。

programme.title: 宇宙閃爍請注意
Wander Together
programme.desc: 重磅打造的全明星爆笑旅行遊戲真人秀，由黃曉明、黃子韜、劉耀文、邵子恆、王鶴棣、于洋組成「宇宙爆閃團」，用高能抽象任務，打造解壓式快樂體驗，去有趣的地方做有意義的事；放下偶像包袱，發送獨一無二的快樂訊號。

programme.title: 超燃青春的合唱
Voices of Youth
programme.desc: 集結25位跨領域青春藝人，組建國內首個全明星流行表演合唱團「燃青團」；跳出傳統音樂真人秀的固化框架，不爭C位、不設淘汰，更關注合唱聲部，以團魂養成、情緒共振為核心，帶來全新觀看體驗；全景式記錄一群年輕人從陌生疏離到默契共生，從個體閃耀到集體綻放的熱血蛻變歷程。

programme.title: 非誠勿擾(2021) (S12)
Perfect Match (2021)
programme.desc: 《非誠勿擾》回歸經典規則。男嘉賓登場後，將通過「愛之請回答」「愛之再判斷」「愛之終決選」三個環節與24位女嘉賓互相了解，還有根據大數據匹配的「智推女生」參與最終決選。陳銘、黃瀾加盟「非誠合夥人」，以全新視角解讀愛情。

programme.title: 國醫少年志 第2季
Traditional Chinese Medicine Youth Chronicles Season 2
programme.desc: 由徐璐、夏之光、高瀚宇、李雅娟組成國醫少年團，通過年輕化視角拆解中醫奧秘，讓中醫藥文化穿越千年時光，讓更多的年輕人讀懂中醫、愛上中醫，看見傳統醫學在現代生活中的蓬勃生命力。

programme.title: 非誠勿擾(2019) (S10)
Perfect Match (2019)
programme.desc: 《非誠勿擾》全新改版，24位女嘉賓分為心動區和觀察區，男嘉賓暫不亮相，在「第二現場」與女嘉賓隔空對話。男女嘉賓通過雙向選擇，決定兩人能否成功牽手。

programme.title: 非來不可 第3季
Fantastic Journey Season 3
programme.desc: 以「山河即課堂，行走即成長」為主題，由何廣智、劉奕君、李雅娟、孫藝洲、楊超越組成的「非來游學團」踏入內蒙古的草原、沙漠、礦洞與峽谷，完成了一場真實、鮮活、不設腳本的人文探索，開啟一場兼具治愈感與知識性的旅程。

programme.title: 與君渡長歡 (短劇)
Eternal Joy With You (Mini drama)
programme.desc: 藥商之女許婉寧前世遭丈夫背叛、親生骨肉被害，含恨重生；為了守護孩子並復仇，她與調查禁藥的金鱗衛大督主裴珩結盟，兩人從互有成見的試探，到相知相許的聯手，不僅粉碎了危害朝政的驚天陰謀，更在夢境與現實的交錯中，讓女主重獲自救的勇氣，開啟了全新人生。

programme.title: 黑月光法則 (短劇)
Princess Revenge (Mini drama)
programme.desc: 名門千金東方曦為愛隱姓埋名打工供養男友，慘遭背叛後覺醒，竟發現自己身處小說世界，成了注定悲劇的惡毒女配；為了改寫命運，她與系統達成賭約，不僅當眾揭穿了渣男的真面目，更發現暗中守護自己的大哥竟是系統化身。這是一場關於覺醒、反殺與破局的奇幻愛戀，挑戰傳統的黑月光法則。

programme.title: 非誠勿擾(2021) (S12)
Perfect Match (2021)
programme.desc: 《非誠勿擾》回歸經典規則。男嘉賓登場後，將通過「愛之請回答」「愛之再判斷」「愛之終決選」三個環節與24位女嘉賓互相了解，還有根據大數據匹配的「智推女生」參與最終決選。陳銘、黃瀾加盟「非誠合夥人」，以全新視角解讀愛情。

programme.title: 音樂緣計劃 第2季
Crush of Music Season 2 (Repackaged)
programme.desc: 將繼續以「音樂牽線，緣分發聲」為主題，賽制上進行了全面創新升級，帶來更具懸念的緣分匹配設定、更多元的趣味互動模式，以及更動人的團隊默契考驗；匯聚周深、薛之謙、單依純等10位實力歌手與新銳音樂人，通過盲選歌單、即興創作等環碰撞靈感，打造專屬合作舞台！

programme.title: 盒子裡的貓
Mystery In The Box
programme.desc: 全明星沉浸式劇情體驗綜藝；圍繞遊戲、喜劇兩大元素，以社會熱點話題為創作基礎，打造不同遊戲主題。一個盒子空間，一群神秘玩家，他們需要在各種離奇、爆笑和反轉中，一步步揭開故事真相，走出盒子，體驗一場專屬的心靈療愈之旅。

programme.title: 美好生活荔枝幫
A Wonderful Life Starts with Health
programme.desc: 兼顧情緒價值輸出，為女性量身打造兼具時尚審美與人文關懷的變裝微綜藝，全方位多角度地向社會傳遞積極的生活態度；種草生活好物、推薦文旅線路、科普健康知識。

programme.title: 說唱夢工廠
Rap Star Dream Maker (Repackaged)
programme.desc: 由周杰倫擔當音樂造夢者，召集夢想生活官劉畊宏和夢想見證官王鶴棣，及四組廠牌經理人GAI周延&布瑞吉Bridge、歐陽靖&小鬼王琳凱、艾熱&早安、VaVa&盛宇，一同為說唱新生代們的追夢之旅保駕護航；打破傳統導師帶隊模式，通過構建真實師徒關系，共同打造獨具特色的說唱廠牌；透過競演激發說唱歌手創作才華，在全民中尋找下一個說唱巨星。

programme.desc: Rosi (Rayna Snova) is the ex-girlfriend of Vino (Jeff Smith); their relationship ended abruptly because Rosi's mother accepted a bribe from Vino's mother to break them up. Rosi, completely failing to recognize Vino behind the costume, ends up venting to him about how her ex cheated on her. Is there a chance for their old flame to be rekindled?

programme.desc: Jirayut travels to Indonesia in search of his biological mother, who abandoned him when he was a child. Along the way, he meets Halda, a street-food vendor selling ketoprak, who claims she can help him locate his mother. However, Halda harbors a sinister motive: she plans to set up a fake mother in order to scheme her way into the inheritance left by Jirayut's late father, which was promised to anyone who could reunite them.

programme.title: Bulan Terbelah di Hati Mas Silver
programme.desc: Fikri is a Manusia Silver (a silver-painted street performer) who falls head over heels for Bulan, a beautiful municipal police (Satpol PP) officer. Due to the nature of their daily routines, their paths cross constantly. One day, while on duty and executing her job with utmost professionalism, Bulan does the unthinkable and arrests Fikri anyway.

programme.title: 世间有她
Hero
programme.desc: 2020年新冠疫情来袭，三位女性在前景不明朗的困境中，各自与朋友和家人找寻出路。从家里的难题到感情关系的挣扎，还有工作上的斗争，这三位女性都坚强地在困境中找寻出路。

programme.title: 命案
Mad Fate
programme.desc: 命理大师遇上嗜血成狂的小东，并算出他会因杀人而有牢狱之灾，于是竭尽所能为他改命。但目击小东杀猫的老警官坚信他是心理变态的连环凶手而步步进逼。最终命理大师能否改变小东的命运？

programme.title: 陪月
Confinement
programme.desc: 怀有身孕的画家王思玲在获奖后，搬进她梦寐以求的大宅，并聘请了陪月。但她在诞下女儿开始坐月的时候，屋内接二连三发生怪事，使母女二人感到极度不安…

programme.title: 消失的凶手
The Vanished Murderer
programme.desc: 故事发生在1932年中国北方，女囚犯傅源利用一把银匙在牢中挖掘隧道，成功逃脱。警官松东路奉命调查此案，通过傅源寄来的信件追踪到香城，揭开她失踪背后的神秘故事，并逐步发现隐藏的阴谋与真相。

programme.title: 七人乐队
Septet: The Story of Hong Kong
programme.desc: 由七位香港不同风格的殿堂级导演，各执导一个故事，史无前例地合奏出一个情怀满溢，由五十年代至未来的香港故事。

programme.title: 失衡凶间之恶念之最
Tales from the Occult: Ultimate Malevolence
programme.desc: 「失衡凶间」最终章包含三个短篇故事，分别围绕着两个中学同学兼好友，一个寻找失踪好友而接受催眠的魔术师，和一个设法逃离诡秘工厦的男子。故事揭开人性最可怕、最丑恶的一面。「失衡凶间」生死无序，一念之距！

programme.title: 我谈的那场恋爱
Love Lies
programme.desc: 妇科名医余笑琴抱着一试无妨的心态下载交友软件，却在网上邂逅一位自称法籍工程师的对象。殊不知，这位对象其实是一名绰号「少年」的新手骗子，并且是网络诈骗集团的一员。随着时间流逝，少年的愧疚感与笑琴的期望日益增强，这段关系愈演愈烈，真假难以区分。

programme.title: 逆鳞
Untouchable
programme.desc: 尊非投身黑白两道通吃的富商黄朝晋门下，成为其左右手。他既要面对帮派厮杀与权力暗斗，还陷于人性的复杂博弈，更在情义与道义之间反复挣扎。最终，他被迫卷入一场以生命为筹码的生死赌局。

programme.title: 断网
Cyber Heist
programme.desc: 黑客发动大规模的网络袭击，幸得网络保安主任卓家俊利用自己研发的防火墙化解危机。怎料病毒攻击原是由家俊上司所操控，家俊亦同时误堕其洗黑钱圈套，为证清白，二人展开激烈的网络攻防。

programme.title: 九龙城寨之围城
Twilight of the Warriors: Walled In
programme.desc: 青年陈洛军因逃难误闯城寨，赫然发现城寨内乱中有序又很包容，从中认定了人生目标，领悟到不少做人的道理。他在城寨内结识了一众好兄弟：信一、十二少、四仔等。兄弟们以龙卷风为首，奋力抵抗恶势力大老板的入侵，并展开连番恶斗，誓死保卫城寨这个安身之地。

programme.title: 出走的决心
Like A Rolling Stone
programme.desc: 中国式好妈妈李红半生任劳任怨，在日复一日的家务与丈夫的冷漠中感到窒息。一场高中同学会意外点燃了她被埋没的青春梦想，她决定打破沉重的家庭枷锁，向妻子与母亲的身份「辞职」。李红毅然驾车出走，独自踏上重启人生的漫漫旅程，在广阔天地间寻回那个遗失已久的自我。

programme.title: 怒潮
Wolf Hiding
programme.desc: 冷血杀手陈安为要替遭到犯罪集团害死的妹妹报仇，与警察及黑帮份子展开一场正邪交锋的复仇行动。

programme.title: 饭戏攻心2
Table for Six 2
programme.desc: 这是《饭戏攻心》的续集，讲述二哥和三哥在大哥离家之际，计划要结婚。最后，他们的婚宴成为一个混乱的战场，婚宴升级为家族斗兽场，造成一场喜上加喜的饭戏！

programme.desc: Cahaya is a beautiful young woman who works at a fish farm owned by Adipura, a wealthy businessman in a village in Sukabumi. One day, Cahaya's father is involved in an accident and is hospitalized. Desperate to find money for his treatment, Cahaya turns to Adipura for help. Adipura agrees, but on one condition: Cahaya must marry him.

programme.title: SAYAP CINTA TERINDAH EPS 33
programme.desc: It tells the story of Dhani, the firm and responsible eldest son, as he strives to take care of his three younger siblings (David, Ariel, and Isyana) in order to fulfill their father Haris's dream of having a harmonious family. Dhani carries a heavy burden, but he faces serious challenges as his siblings resent him and each of them harbors their own complicated secrets.

programme.title: CINTA SEPENUH JIWA EPS 137
programme.desc: Lala is a young girl, the second daughter of Andi and Desi, who since childhood has carried enthusiasm and a smile with her every step. Her life is simple but full of color thanks to one thing she truly loves: cooking. For Lala, the kitchen is not just a place to prepare ingredients. It is a space for expression, a place where she pours out her emotions, wraps stories into every seasoning, and serves love through every dish. With the support of Hasbi—her boyfriend who later becomes her husban...

programme.title: CAHAYA TERINDAH EPS 65-66
programme.desc: A drama series that tells the story of Indah (Ranty Maria) and her struggle to find her biological family after discovering that she was adopted. She runs away to Jakarta from her adoptive father (Jamal), who intends to sell her, and ends up working for the Hendardi family, where she faces romantic conflicts and emotional mysteries from her past.

programme.title: TURUN RANJANG EPS 34
programme.desc: Albi (Samuel Zylgwyn) is forced to marry his sister-in-law, Naza (Rachquel Nesia), at the request of his father-in-law, Wira. This decision is made for the sake of caring for baby Zia (Faradilla Yoshi), Albi's wife, who falls into a coma after giving birth. This pressured marriage becomes difficult for both Albi and Naza, as they were previously in love with other people.

programme.title: TERIKAT JANJI EPS 34
programme.desc: A drama series that tells the story of Davina, a conglomerate's daughter who falls into poverty after being betrayed. She is forced to pretend to be in a relationship with Sena, a ketoprak street vendor. This fake relationship, meant to protect her reputation, becomes complicated when Sena is actually an undercover intelligence agent on a mission tied to his past—further intensified by conflicts involving a stepmother and past betrayals.

programme.title: CINTA BERAKHIR BAHAGIA 110
programme.desc: Adisty, a beautiful young woman who serves as the backbone of her family, nearly becomes a sex worker to pay off her family's debts. programme.title: 灼灼韶华
Wild Ambition Bloom
programme.desc: 1916年，褚韶华为救哥哥而嫁给陈记药铺大少爷陈大顺，她以诚信和出色的商业得到陈父的赏识，成为药铺管理人。陈父和陈大顺意外去世后，陈二顺继承药铺并败光家财，药铺陷入绝境。褚韶华在艰辛努力下，开了华顺药铺养活一家老小。褚韶华后决意携手初恋情人夏初开启新生活，却遭陈二顺和陈母阻挠。陈家被土匪洗劫一空，褚韶华也在这次劫难中失去女儿，伤心不已的她独自出走上海。褚韶华在上海永新百货业绩突出，受经营奇才闻知秋之邀共同创业，逐步成长为胆略过人、重诺守信的女商人。This is the story of Chu, who came from a family of traditional Chinese medicine in the early years of China and her life revolving round three men - Xia Chu, Chen Da Shun, and Wen Zhi Qiu. Not succumbing to the unfair arrangements of the times and fate, Chu gradually ex...

programme.title: 他从火光中走来
Bright Eyes in the Dark
programme.desc: 林陆骁拥有过人的消防技巧和丰富的消防经验，是北浔市特勤一站站长。因缘际会下，他被选中成了一档旨在科普消防知识的真人节目的教官。在节目中林陆骁偶遇自己多年前从火场中救下的舞蹈演员南初。南初对林陆骁充满好感，但林陆骁却因深知自己职业的危险而不愿靠近。年轻而勇敢的新一代消防员如邵一九、秦十全等崭露头角，从国外带回先进装备技术的楼明冶也回到了消防队。老中青三代消防员们在火灾、地震、空中救援等灾情救援中通力合作，将北浔市的消防安全水平提升了一个台阶。南初与林陆骁也在逐渐深入了解中确定了自己的心意，面临最危险的森林火灾，林陆骁与他的队友们依然选择逆火前进。

programme.title: 大泼猴
The Legends Of Monkey King
programme.desc:
天道变数，石妖提前三百年破石而出，生存堪忧的石妖踏上了寻仙之路。他在求仙路上九死一生，幸得金丝雀舍命相救，石妖因此许下了复活金丝雀的诺言。为了实现诺言，石妖一路拜师修行，其间与天真烂漫的风铃和孤傲高冷的杨岚分别暗生情愫，还卷入了众妖与天庭的对抗之中。
A mortal man accidentally time-travels to the past and becomes the Monkey King. Unwilling to accept his fate, he embarks on a journey that brings him to face gods and demons.

programme.title: 型男大主厨
Stylish Man
programme.desc: 台湾广受欢迎的常青美食料理节目，由2006年始播至今，2011年还获选金钟奖的最佳综合节目主持人奖。每一期将有不同的主题：“大明星來下廚”由兩位明星或两个明星档分組對抗，拿出自己的拿手菜對抗比拼；“五分钟出好菜”由两位厨师根据指定食材，在五分钟内烹煮出易学美味的一道菜等。这是一个富有娱乐效果的轻松美食节目，能够持续制作这么多年不是没有理由的。

programme.title: 乡野有真味第三季
Country Roads Delicious Food S3
programme.desc: 《乡野有真味第三季》将镜头投向中国南方的隐秘角落——广东、广西、浙江、福建、湖南、江西、安徽、贵州八省，深入竹林溪涧、古村深巷，探访那些颠覆味蕾认知的“暗黑”美食与新奇风味，揭开乡土食材与地域文化交织的味觉密码。“Country Roads Delicious Food S3” turns to the hidden corners of southern China, the eight provinces of Guangdong, Guangxi, Zhejiang, Fujian, Hunan, Jiangxi, Anhui and Guizhou. Venturing deep into bamboo groves, mountain streams and narrow lanes of ancient villages, the series explores “obscure” delicacies and novel flavours that challenge our taste buds, unveiling the culinary secrets wo...

programme.title: 两岸一味第一季&第二季
The Flavourful Link Across the Strait S1 & S2
programme.desc: 以街头巷尾的民间味道为联结，追溯两岸美食的中华渊源，讲述两岸故事，共鸣情感与文化。六大主题版块，30种两岸吃食，60组人文故事，用两岸一脉共生的食之味，展现两岸一根同源的人情味，讲述两岸饮食的人间烟火，追寻中华民族的味觉乡愁。

programme.title: 勇敢无双龙秀晶
The Brave Yong Su Jeong
programme.desc: 该剧为一部浪漫复仇剧，讲述了梦想成为现代版巨商林尚玉的女子龙秀晶与将命运托付给她的吝啬鬼绝症患者吕义柱相遇后，两人共同展开复仇的故事。剧中还涉及与财阀家族相关的出生秘密等人物关系。Yong Su-Jeong is a popular but shy-in-love host who has a crush on a rich heir, Joo Woo-Jin, while hardworking Yeo Ui-Joo’s life changes when he discovers he’s also part of the same wealthy family.

programme.desc: 一心想要查找缉毒警察男友死亡真相的女警花邓妍，在一次解救人质的意外行动中大放异彩，被调到打拐办任代理主任。邓妍通过缜密的推理、精准的判断力以及奋不顾身的行动，让原本持怀疑态度的同事变为钦佩和坚定支持。面对罪犯的狡猾和凶残，邓妍与同事们共同努力，剥茧抽丝，终将拐卖妇女儿童犯罪团伙的一个个犯罪嫌疑人绳之以法。与此同时，男友被害的真相也渐渐浮出水面。Police officer Hua Deng Yan hopes to join the anti-drug team to find out the truth behind her boyfriend's death. programme.title: 祈今朝
Sword and Fairy
programme.desc: 越今朝和越祈二人在乌岩村相伴三年，有着神奇的“共鸣”关系，却对各自的身世一无所知。二人携手闯荡江湖，希望找回过往记忆。双越二人被卷入启魂圣宗作乱和洛家堡血祭等神秘事件之中，而在对抗圣宗过程中意外让越祈被封印的回忆和情感被开启。随着事件发展，双越结识了洛家堡双子洛埋名和洛昭言、千年狼妖闲卿、顾寒江和明绣师徒以及居十方等江湖人士，二人的真实身份也逐渐揭开。

programme.title: Wild Tales from the Farm Season 1
programme.desc: It's spring, and the farm is bursting with new life. Watch a ewe give birth to twins, an orphaned Hereford calf struggle to find a surrogate mother, and the top hen nestle down in her maternity coop.

programme.title: America's Wild Seasons Season 1
programme.desc: It's spring: the season of courtship and new life. Witness nature awaken from its slumber in many forms, from the blossoms that explode in the rain-soaked desert of Arizona to the fuzzy wood ducklings that leap from their nests.

programme.title: America's Wild Seasons Season 1
programme.desc: Summer brings long, warm days for wildlife to thrive. Watch animals learn new skills, compete for mates, and escape predators as they try to make the most of the short season.

programme.title: Secrets of the Enchanted Waters Season 1
programme.desc: Freeze time as water becomes a force of change in Earth's most frigid ecosystems. Hunt for unsuspecting seals with polar bears, bathe in natural hot springs with macaques, and try out a unique survival strategy with Arctic foxes.

programme.title: Cub Camp Season 1
programme.desc: Get to know Winston, a tiny abandoned cub who imprints on Judy as she nurses him 24-7. Feel the heartbreak as she severs their emotional attachment and teaches this sweet little fellow how to be a grown-up, independent bear in the non-human world.

programme.title: Cub Camp Season 1
programme.desc: Welcome sisters Xiba, Xyla, and Xola, a trio of starving orphans who turn Winston's world upside down before gentle Xola teaches him a lesson about friendship. Then monitor new cubs Yasmine and Yara, who get reacquainted after a stressful separation.

programme.title: Wild Dogs: Pack vs. Pride Season 2
programme.desc: Feel your heart race when the Kakumbi tree a leopard who's been stalking them. Join Julz on a ZCP lion-collaring mission, go fishing with scout Simon, explore mealtime pack hierarchy, and witness a heartbreaking vigil for a badly injured Kakumbi pup.

programme.title: Cub Camp Season 1

programme.title: Deep Dive North America Season 1
programme.desc: Bundle up as Lizzie heads north to tag sharks and witness first-hand the slow, sobering disappearance of sea ice. Do time in bear jail with polar bears who are caught raiding a town for food after their icy hunting grounds diminish.

programme.title: Africa's Wild Year Season 1
programme.desc: Autumn in Africa brings opportunities. Cape Fur seals, Samango monkeys, chameleons, impala, and more respond to the season. Autumn triggers changes in the lives of many animals. Rare creatures reveal themselves and predators gather to take advantage.

programme.title: Africa's Wild Year Season 1
programme.desc: Be an eyewitness to the death and resurrection that winter brings to Africa. Observe what comes with shorter days, from drought conditions to frigid winds, and marvel at the survival skills of animals and plants as they face the season's fury.

programme.title: Tusker: Brotherhood of Elephants
programme.desc: Become immersed in the intricate lives of tuskers with Craig, Pascal, and Esau, three male African elephants in all stages of life. Get a rare glimpse into the subtle language, complex interactions, and deep bonds of the world's largest land mammal.

programme.title: Wild Tales from the Farm Season 1
programme.desc: Experience life on the farm as things heat up for summer. Watch animals swelter in a rare heatwave, try to stay cool in the nearby freshwater stream, and stash supplies for fall.

Along the way, there's a brief detour to carve up the fresh powder on the black runs at Chongli. Dykes then immerses himself in the footsteps of centuries-old explorers at Wulouggou before tracing the Great Wall to its intersection with the Yellow River-a symbolic convergence of Chinese history and nature.

programme.title: Southwest Islands
programme.desc: In the far south west of Japan, there is a chain of islands stretching towards the tropics - a place where all life is influenced by the power of the sea, and where volcanoes and typhoons are forces to be reckoned with. The journey begins at an island at the top of the chain and travels south, revealing unexpected stories of isolation, unique wildlife and unsolved mysteries.

programme.title: Autumn
programme.desc: For the animals of the polar regions, autumn means dramatic battles and epic journeys. Polar bears gather in large numbers on the Arctic coast as they wait for the return of the ice. Soon tempers fray and violent sparring contests break out. Meanwhile two thousand beluga whales head for one special estuary, to thrash their snow-white bodies against the gravel and exfoliate - it's a gigantic 'whale spa'. Inland, the tundra undergoes a dramatic transformation from green to fiery red.

programme.title: Strange Worlds
programme.desc: Professor Brian Cox explores the solar system's weirdest worlds - the misfits and oddballs with freakish shapes and sizes. He also finds out how simple forces have created such bizarre places.

programme.title: Winter
programme.desc: There is no greater test for life than winter as temperatures plummet to 70 below and winds reach 200kph. Darkness and ice extend across the polar regions and only a few remarkable survivors gamble on remaining. We join a female polar bear trekking into the Arctic mountains to give birth as the first blizzards arrive. Out on the frozen ocean, the entire world's population of spectacled eider ducks brave the winter in a giant ice hole kept open by ferocious currents.

programme.title: Hokkaido
programme.desc: Hokkaido is Japan's northernmost - and wildest - island, a place totally unlike the rest of the country. Every year, it swings from a bitter Siberian winter into the warmth of a Mediterranean-like summer, when the thaw reveals a landscape changed beyond all recognition. It takes tough animals and tough people with real ingenuity to survive, and even thrive, in this ever-changing place.

programme.desc: The Go Jetters spring into action when Glitch's mini-master toys invade Hong Kong Harbour.

programme.title: Horsey Ride
programme.desc: When Bluey forgets to put her favourite toy away, Socks grabs it! The kids stage a horsey wedding to distract her, with Dad and Uncle Stripe as the horses!

programme.title: Charades
programme.desc: Bluey and Bingo want everyone to play charades, but Muffin and Socks are too young to understand the rules and Nana must think quickly to keep the game on track.

programme.title: Onesies
programme.desc: When mum's sister Brandy comes over for a visit, she brings the kids onesies as a present, which has an unexpected effect on Bingo.

programme.title: Tradies
programme.desc: Bluey and Bingo hide under the house and spy on two mysterious tradies working in the backyard, wondering what they're up to.

programme.title: Andy and the Tiger Cubs
programme.desc: Andy, Jen and Scout head to the Bandhavgarh tiger reserve in India on a baby animal mission to track down a female tiger and her new born cubs. Along the way, our team outwit a sloth that strays dangerously close to the den where the cubs are resting.

programme.title: Mud
programme.desc: Bella and Lift visit the Cloud Kitchen, where Patch is busy with the Playtimers making a tasty treat called Munchy Muddy Meadows.

programme.title: The Diplomacy Badge
programme.desc: Betty and Sargent Ant just want perfection, but no one seems to be listening to their shouting! They need a lesson in diplomacy to learn how to speak in a more sensitive way.

programme.title: The Senses Badge
programme.desc: Roly has lost his best potato but Duggee finds it using his sense of smell. But what is a sense? Time for the Squirrels to learn about the five senses and earn their Senses Badge.

programme.title: The Comic Badge
programme.desc: Duggee is reading the Squirrels one of his favourite comics. They eagerly want to know the ending, but the comic was discontinued. Luckily Duggee has the comic badge, he can show the Squirrels how to create their own ending.

programme.title: Mission Manatee, USA
programme.desc: The Go Jetters are in the Gulf of Mexico to learn about Manatees - peaceful water mammals that spend most of their time either sleeping or eating sea-grass - which could be why they're sometimes called sea-cows!

programme.title: Endangered Species, São Paulo, Brazil
programme.desc: The Go Jetters are upset after hearing how many struggling species there are that need help to survive. Ubercorn tries to cheer them up by suggesting they head to the pristine forests of Sao Paulo.

programme.title: The Inventor's Spectacular Bridge
programme.desc: When the Rickety Old Bridge collapses, trapping Toby and Henrietta on the other side of the ravine, Inventor Ruth is asked to build a new one.

programme.title: The Mouse's Birthday
programme.desc: Sarah's hoping for a nice quiet birthday, but is not getting her wish once her friends arrive...

programme.title: Tortoise Snooze
programme.desc: When it is time for Tortoise to hibernate, Sarah and Duck help him find a quiet place to sleep.

programme.title: Kite
programme.desc: Stanley helps Little Woo and Seamus fly their new kite. It gets stuck up a tree and breaks. Using leaves and sticks, they build a better one, only for that to get stuck.

programme.title: Heavy
programme.desc: Stanley and Morris put too many boxes on the barge and now one end is sinking and the other is lifting up. Stanley get's the townsfolk to help level it out.

programme.title: I Like Tractors
programme.desc: From riding cows to having pigs in the house, the funny animals chat about everything brilliant about farms.

programme.title: It's Time to See the Planets

programme.title: Perfect
programme.desc: For her Father's Day card, Bluey sets out to draw a picture of herself and her father together. While recalling her favourite memories of playing with Bandit, Bluey struggles with the idea that her drawing must be perfect. Chilli tries to convince Bluey that perfection isn't easy, or absolutely necessary.

programme.title: Explorers
programme.desc: While waiting to be picked up from school, Jack plays at being a sailor trying to find his way back home to Australia. Meanwhile, Jack's Dad has got lost on route to collect him.

programme.title: Phones
programme.desc: Bluey and Bingo want to play restaurants with Grandad, but it's a little different than he's used to... he's going to need an app to order the food!

programme.title: The Lost Property Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels have just got some new walkie-talkies and are having so much fun with them. Duggee calls the Squirrels to come for some blueberry juice, but as Tag is running, he trips over a car and falls through a secret door in the wall! Communicating through his walkie-talkie, Tag doesn't know where he is. He can see lots and lots of things around him but no one has any idea where this room is in the house!

programme.title: The Pet Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels meet a scruffelump in the woods, and despite Duggee's reservations, take him in. But they soon learn the responsibilities of taking care of a pet.

programme.desc: Bluey and Bingo hide under the house and spy on two mysterious tradies working in the backyard, wondering what they're up to.
